raw.description:
About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a Client Strategy Manager to own the adoption strategy for your book of business. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Client Strategy, you'll lead customers from cross-departmental alignment through implementation, launch, measurable adoption, and long-term value realization.

What You'll Do

This is not a high-volume SaaS account management role. You'll own a small number of complex enterprise homebuilders and help them adopt Higharc in ways that materially change how their business operates. Adoption here isn't about usage, it's about changing how builders work.

You'll partner with a dedicated Project Manager who owns project plans, reporting, documentation, and system hygiene. With that discipline in place, you focus on customer outcomes, executive alignment, adoption strategy, change management, and account health.

Expect to:

  • Own adoption outcomes from post-sale alignment through launch, rollout, value realization, and long-term account health.

  • Lead executive conversations on your own around business goals, adoption milestones, risks, tradeoffs, and value.

  • Guide clients beyond recreating legacy workflows toward new workflows, decision rights, and the adoption behaviors required to realize value.

  • Orchestrate internal teams across Implementation, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to keep outcomes moving.

  • Diagnose adoption risk early, align stakeholders, and restore momentum when programs stall.

  • Translate patterns in client friction into structured product, implementation, and account intelligence.

About You

You're a strategic client relationship owner who can multithread through messy, high-stakes operational change. You're comfortable standing on your own with senior stakeholders, you know when to pull in executive support from Higharc, and you can tell a clear story about where a customer is, where they need to go, what's at risk, and what decisions move them forward.

You bring curiosity and horsepower to quickly understand how builders operate across Architecture, Purchasing, Sales, and Operations. You're highly self-directed: you investigate ambiguity, form a point of view, and move work forward without close management.

You have:

  • 5+ years in client success, implementation leadership, enterprise account management, consulting, solutions, or program leadership, with direct ownership of complex, high-value customers or transformation programs

  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to independently influence senior customer stakeholders

  • Excellent judgment in diagnosing customer risk, adoption friction, stakeholder misalignment, and organizational blockers

  • Strong consultative and cross-functional leadership instincts — you can challenge customers respectfully when legacy assumptions limit value, and lead across implementation, product, engineering, sales, support, and executive teams

  • Comfort using data, customer health signals, and AI-enabled tools to understand account health and adoption progress

  • The ability to synthesize project details into an accurate account narrative without owning every administrative detail

  • Willingness to travel 25%, with occasional fluctuations during customer launch periods

A major plus if you also bring:

  • Experience in residential homebuilding, construction technology, AEC, manufacturing, ERP, or other operationally complex industries

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

raw.description:
Job Title - IP Lawyer

About the Role

We are seeking a highly-skilled and commercially-aware IP Lawyer to lead the protection and management of the organisations intellectual property assets in the cybersecurity and IT services domain. The role encompasses strategic oversight of IP strategy and policy, hands-on execution of filings, enforcement, licensing and ensuring the businesss technology and brand assets are safeguarded and monetised appropriately.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement a comprehensive IP strategy aligned with business goals: map asset types (trademarks, patents, copyrights, trade secrets, software code) by geography and class, and manage annual filing/renewal road-maps.

Conduct IP clearance and due-diligence searches for trademarks, patents, designs, software modules and domains; advise on go/no-go decisions for new product launches or branding initiatives.

Manage prosecution and portfolio maintenance: supervise filings, handle examiner actions, coordinate renewals, recordals, and maintain an audit-ready docket or registry.

Oversee enforcement and dispute resolution: respond to infringements (digital, counterfeiting, domain abuse), handle takedowns, oppositions/cancellations, customs seizures, UDRP/URS, litigation support as required.

Draft, review and negotiate IP-related provisions in commercial agreements: licensing, technology transfer, distribution, service contracts, software-as-a-service (SaaS) and outsourcing agreements.

Provide IP guidance and training to internal stakeholders (engineering, product, marketing, sales) on correct use of IP, brand protection, open-source compliance and risk mitigation.

Engage and manage external counsel, agents and service providers; monitor budgets and deliverables associated with IP enforcement, filings and licenses.

Monitor market developments, IP jurisprudence, regulatory changes in the UAE/GCC region and globally; integrate insights and recommend improvements or SOPs for IP protection.

Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards to senior management or board: portfolio performance, risk exposures, KPI tracking (e.g., registration success rate, average time to takedown, cost-benefit).

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.), Juris Doctor (J.D.) or equivalent; admission to practise in at least one recognised jurisdiction.

Minimum 57 years of hands-on experience in intellectual property law (preferably within software/IT services or cybersecurity) experience in the UAE/GCC region is highly desirable.

Proven track record in trademark and/or patent prosecution, brand protection (especially digital), domain/dispute management and multi-jurisdictional enforcement.

Strong drafting and negotiation skills of commercial/legal documents including licensing, distribution and tech transfer agreements.

Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills; ability to advise senior business executives and cross-functional teams.

Familiarity with IP management tools/systems (e.g., trademark/patent databases), strong proficiency in MS Office and ability to work with legal KPI dashboards.

Fluency in English required; Arabic proficiency is a strong advantage.

Key Competencies & Behaviours

Strategic thinker with commercial acumen: able to link IP work to business value, risk mitigation and competitive advantage.

Detail-oriented and organised: able to manage multiple deadlines, prioritise filings/enforcements and maintain accuracy in high-volume workloads.

Influential and collaborative: builds strong relationships with internal teams and external partners; able to influence without formal authority.

Results-oriented and proactive: takes ownership, drives initiatives, escalates risks appropriately and ensures delivery to agreed metrics.

Adaptable and resilient: comfortable working in a fast-moving IT/cyber-environment, managing evolving threats, digital brand risks and cross-border issues.

Integrity and confidentiality: handles sensitive legal and business information with high ethical standards.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and benefits aligned with UAE market and experience.

Opportunity to play a key role in a fast-growing IT services/cybersecurity business with a strong focus on technology-driven IP assets.

Exposure to complex global IP matters, cross-jurisdictional enforcement, digital brand protection and strategic legal leadership.

Professional development and growth potential in a dynamic environment with impactful responsibility.

Apply now!

Quantum Sky is hiring a Cloud Security Engineer (AWS & GCP) to join our team of cloud, security, and compliance experts. This role is primarily focused on day‑to‑day security engineering, including system hardening, vulnerability remediation, cloud operations, and security tool management across AWS & GCP environments.

In addition to regular business‑hours responsibilities, engineers participate in a structured after‑hours 24×7 on‑call rotation (primary or backup) to support response to incidents, alerts, and escalations for customers operating under FedRAMP, FISMA, and NIST 800‑53 frameworks.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform systems administration and maintenance including patching, vulnerability scanning, compliance scanning and remediation, backups, and recovery for cloud workloads.

    • GitLab

    • Trivy

    • Terraform
    • CloudFormation
    • Ansible

Overview

LMI is seeking a Platform Engineer to design, deploy, operate, and sustain secure cloud-native platform capabilities for a Department of War mission partner. This remote role will focus on Amazon Web Services (AWS)-hosted Kubernetes environments that connect to and operate within the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN). The Platform Engineer will support platform architecture, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, application onboarding, cybersecurity compliance, observability, troubleshooting, and continuous service improvement. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can translate mission and application requirements into reliable, repeatable, secure, and supportable platform services.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This is a remote position within the continental United States and requires an active Secret security clearance. The employee must be available during core working hours aligned to the mission partner and may be required to travel periodically to government or LMI locations for integration, testing, maintenance, or mission support.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, configure, operate, and sustain AWS-based platform services supporting mission-critical Department of War applications and workloads.
  • Administer Kubernetes clusters and supporting services, including cluster configuration, node groups, namespaces, role-based access control, ingress, service discovery, storage, secrets management, network policies, autoscaling, upgrades, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Build and maintain repeatable infrastructure and platform configurations using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or equivalent customer-approved technologies.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, GitOps workflows, container registries, artifact repositories, automated testing, and deployment controls.
  • Onboard, configure, deploy, and sustain containerized applications across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Integrate platform services with DODIN network services, identity and access management, public key infrastructure, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, endpoint security, and other government enterprise services.
  • Implement and maintain secure platform configurations aligned with approved security baselines, Defense Information Systems Agency Security Technical Implementation Guides, Risk Management Framework requirements, and Authority to Operate conditions.
  • Monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, security posture, and application health using AWS-native and customer-approved observability tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving Linux, containers, Kubernetes, AWS services, networking, Domain Name System, certificates, encryption, load balancing, storage, compute, identity, and application dependencies.
  • Perform platform patching, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, backup, recovery, and controlled upgrade activities while minimizing mission disruption.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, network, software, data, systems engineering, and mission teams to resolve dependencies and deliver integrated capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain platform architecture documentation, configuration standards, operating procedures, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, deployment instructions, and knowledge articles.
  • Support technical interchange meetings, architecture reviews, release planning, change control, incident response, root-cause analysis, and after-action reviews.
  • Provide clear status reporting on platform health, technical risk, security findings, maintenance activities, dependencies, and recommended actions.
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance and time-sensitive incident response outside normal working hours when required by mission needs.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Minimum of five years of directly relevant professional experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, systems engineering, Linux systems administration, or a closely related technical field.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience operating, integrating, or sustaining systems connected to the DODIN, including familiarity with Department of Defense network access, security, configuration, and operational requirements.
  • Current Department of Defense 8570-compliant certification appropriate to the assigned information assurance or cybersecurity workforce functions.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience deploying, administering, troubleshooting, and upgrading Kubernetes environments.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and services, including compute, networking, storage, identity, security, monitoring, and automation capabilities.
  • Experience administering Linux-based systems and troubleshooting operating system, process, package, file system, permissions, networking, and performance issues.
  • Experience building, securing, deploying, and operating containers using Docker, Open Container Initiative-compatible technologies, or equivalent container tooling.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, configuration automation, source control, continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, and repeatable deployment practices.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, Domain Name System, load balancing, virtual private networks, Transport Layer Security, certificates, and network segmentation.
  • Working knowledge of Department of Defense cybersecurity and authorization practices, including Risk Management Framework activities, Security Technical Implementation Guides, vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate requirements.
  • Ability to independently diagnose complex technical problems, coordinate across multiple technical teams, document findings, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, risks, and recommendations to engineering, cybersecurity, program, and mission stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, protect government information, maintain reliable connectivity, and travel periodically as required.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience operating Kubernetes on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service within AWS GovCloud or another Department of Defense-authorized cloud environment.
  • Experience supporting systems at Department of Defense Impact Level 4, Impact Level 5, or Impact Level 6.
  • Experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, Helm, Kustomize, or comparable platform engineering and GitOps tools.
  • Experience with observability technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch, Elastic, Fluent Bit, or comparable logging and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with container security, software supply-chain controls, image scanning, software bills of materials, Iron Bank images, or hardened container baselines.
  • Experience integrating platform services with Common Access Card authentication, Department of Defense public key infrastructure, identity providers, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, or Zero Trust architectures.
  • Experience with service mesh, secrets management, policy as code, automated compliance, high availability, disaster recovery, or multi-account AWS architectures.
  • AWS, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, Certified Kubernetes Application Developer, Linux, cybersecurity, or related professional certification.
  • Prior experience directly supporting a Department of War mission partner, combatant command, military service component, Special Operations Forces organization, or other national security customer.

Target salary range: $135,000 - $230,000

Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

This leader will be accountable for developing a high-performing sales team, executing against revenue targets, improving pipeline creation and conversion, and helping customers solve complex capital planning and facilities challenges through Gordian’s solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on sales leader who knows how to coach sellers through complex, consultative sales cycles while creating accountability around pipeline development, opportunity management, forecasting, and execution. Experience selling into the public sector and navigating government procurement, budgeting, contracting, and RFP processes is highly valuable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of SLED Account Executives to consistently achieve individual and team revenue goals.
  • Establish clear expectations around prospecting, pipeline generation, account planning, opportunity progression, forecasting, and closing.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, deal strategy sessions, and performance coaching focused on both results and seller development.
  • Maintain strong forecast discipline and provide leadership with an accurate, evidence-based view of pipeline, risk, and expected performance.
  • Coach sellers on complex, consultative opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, executive buyers, procurement teams, and lengthy public-sector buying cycles.
  • Drive adoption and consistent execution of Gordian's sales methodology, CRM requirements, qualification standards, and sales processes.
  • Help the team develop compelling business cases around facility condition, deferred maintenance, capital prioritization, budgeting, risk, and long-term capital planning.
  • Partner closely with Business Development, Pre-Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Customer Success, and other Gordian teams to move opportunities efficiently from discovery through contracting and delivery.
  • Build a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
  • Identify performance gaps early and develop clear coaching and action plans to improve results.
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, training, and development of new Account Executives as the organization grows.
  • Use sales data and KPIs to identify trends, diagnose pipeline or conversion challenges, and implement actions that improve team performance.
  • Ensure sellers understand and appropriately navigate public-sector procurement requirements, contracting vehicles, RFPs, budgeting cycles, and funding considerations.
  • Participate in customer meetings and strategic opportunities when leadership involvement can help advance the sale or strengthen executive relationships.

What We're Looking For
The strongest candidate will bring demonstrated success leading B2B sales teams in a complex, consultative environment, with experience selling into State and Local Government strongly preferred. They should have a track record of coaching sellers to quota attainment, building pipeline, managing forecasts, and improving sales execution—not simply managing activity.

They should also be comfortable operating in an environment where deals can involve long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, procurement requirements, contracting complexity, and significant coordination across internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably within SaaS, professional services, facilities, construction technology, asset management, capital planning, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of direct sales management experience with responsibility for quota-carrying sellers.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams against revenue and pipeline targets.
  • Experience selling to State and Local Government organizations strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of government procurement, RFPs, contracting vehicles, budgeting, and public-sector sales cycles.
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, CRM, and sales analytics capabilities.
  • Experience coaching a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC, SPICED, Challenger, or similar.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to balance accountability with coaching and employee development.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a matrixed organization.
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events, team meetings, and strategic opportunities as needed.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means building a team that creates enough qualified pipeline to consistently achieve its targets, forecasts accurately, advances opportunities with discipline, develops strong executive relationships, and works effectively with Gordian's internal partners. Just as importantly, this manager will develop stronger sellers—creating clarity around expectations, coaching gaps early, recognizing strong performance, and building a team culture centered on accountability and customer outcomes.

raw.description:
Overview

The Fair Lending Officer Sr. is responsible for developing, implementing, and executing the organization’s HMDA and Fair Lending programs, encompassing compliance risks associated with residential real estate and consumer lending. The Fair Lending Officer Sr. should be conscious of streamlining efforts, cost-effectiveness, safety and soundness, and proper maintenance of the risk and internal control structures.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain a sound knowledge of State and Federal regulations and laws related to Fair Lending and HMDA
  • Direct the monitoring of compliance with applicable laws and regulations and update relevant members of management regarding the adequacy of current policies and regulatory compliance efforts
  • Design and execute Fair Lending Risk assessments to ensure compliance risks associated with Fair Lending laws, regulations, and guidance’s are adequately identified and addressed
  • Identify gaps in product/service offerings and recommend lending, service, and investment strategies to support the Credit Union's Fair Lending and HMDA reporting efforts under large institution performance criteria
  • Provide guidance and training to Logix staff regarding complex compliance issues related to Fair Lending
  • Evaluate and design programs to ensure appropriate level of compliance within the company
  • Interact with all levels of the Credit Union to communicate and disseminate compliance concepts and issues
  • Develop, administer and maintain a sustainable Fair Lending Compliance Program, including program documentation, policies, procedures, reporting, data inputs and best practices
  • Oversee and conduct the development and maintenance of sustainable data repositories and related reporting to identify, risk-rate, and escalate Fair Lending and technical HMDA reporting issues to the appropriate levels of management. This includes both quality assurance of HMDA data, as well as underwriting, pricing, marketing, redlining, steering, and geographic distribution analysis for Annual Fair Lending compliance
  • Develop and maintain a sustainable technical HMDA reporting process, and a risk-based process to identify and evaluate patterns and practices for Fair Lending
  • Identify data elements that need to be captured and work with appropriate departments to ensure data is gathered timely and accurately
  • Assist subject matter experts and Logix departments in the identification and mitigation of risks relevant to Fair Lending and HMDA reporting
  • Maintain a current library of regulations, interpretations of the regulations and other reference materials on Fair Lending and HMDA compliance matters
  • Coordinate compliance-related communication with regulatory agencies, facilitate the conduct of regulatory examinations and assist management in coordinating the correction of deficiencies noted in examination reports
  • Review reports of findings prepared by Internal Audit and Federal and Federal regulatory agencies relating to regulatory compliance audits, and ensure findings and recommendations are monitored and remediated in a timely manner
  • Manage escalations from business units on heightened Fair Lending risks
  • Review complaints received which allege discrimination or have fair lending concerns
  • Work closely with Consumer Lending and Residential Real Estate management teams
  • Participate in various committees such as Compliance, Enterprise Risk Management, Senior and Junior Loan Committees, Loan Quality, Branch Deployment and Sales/Marketing/Lending planning

Qualifications

Education

  • Min/Preferred:
  • Education Level: 4 Year / Bachelors Degree
  • Description: Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) in Accounting, Business or Finance from four-year college or university

Experience

  • Minimum Years of Experience: 5-7
  • Preferred Years of Experience: 10
  • A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in the field of regulatory compliance in the financial services industry or with a state or federal banking agency is required.
  • Comments: 7-10 years' experience and/or training in the financial services industry, or equivalent combination of education and experience with a focus on Fair Lending and HMDA reporting

Knowledge, Skills & Ability

  • Well-organized, efficient, detail-oriented self-starter, able to work independently
  • Excellent analytical ability, and the ability to compile reporting from disparate data sources, conduct thorough research, interpret and understand laws and regulations, and provide workable recommendations and solutions to problems
  • Broad knowledge of, and practical experience with, credit union or other financial institution operating areas, functions, products and services and the laws and regulations which apply to credit unions
  • Ability to handle simultaneously, multiple tasks and changing priorities in an efficient and effective manner
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • The ability to work with all levels of management and credit union staff, as well as members

raw.title: Senior Database Engineer
raw.excerpt: Datavail is hiring a Senior Database Engineer/SQL Server DBA to join our high-performing team supporting mission-critical database systems across a wide range of clients and industries.
raw.description:
Datavail is hiring a Senior Database Engineer/SQL Server DBA to join our high-performing team supporting mission-critical database systems across a wide range of clients and industries. This isn't a traditional, reactive DBA role — we're looking for a forward-looking database professional who thinks like an engineer: automating instead of repeating manual work, treating cloud-native platforms as the default rather than the exception, and getting ahead of problems before they become a ticket. As a leading managed services provider, we deliver 24x7 support through a proven multi-tiered model, consistently meeting and exceeding client SLAs

We're looking for a senior-level SQL Server specialist who operates as a trusted technical advisor — someone who goes beyond reactive troubleshooting to proactively identify risk, tune performance, and guide clients on cloud and architecture strategy. The ideal candidate will serve as the Primary DBA for one or more clients, building strong client relationships while leading service delivery with a blend of hands-on engineering depth and consultative guidance. This is a full-time position with full medical benefits

Travel: Up to 20% domestic (US) travel for client onsite visits — this role is relationship-driven, and in-person time with clients is part of building that trust

  • Performance Tuning & Cloud-Native Database Expertise (Core Focus)
  • This is a defining requirement for the role, not a secondary skill:
  • T-SQL query optimization — reading and rewriting execution plans, resolving parameter sniffing, statistics/cardinality issues, and Query Store-based tuning
  • Rewriting and refactoring existing stored procedures and T-SQL code for performance — not just tuning execution plans, but redesigning logic and set-based approaches where needed
  • Indexing strategy — designing and maintaining clustered/nonclustered/covering indexes, evaluating columnstore where appropriate, and managing fragmentation/maintenance without breaking SLAs
  • Root-cause performance diagnosis — wait-stats analysis, CPU/memory/I-O bottleneck isolation, tempdb contention, and blocking/deadlock resolution
  • Cloud-native platform tuning — hands-on optimization specific to Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and AWS RDS for SQL Server: correct service tier/vCore or DTU sizing, storage throughput/IOPS tuning, elastic pool configuration, and working within PaaS resource-governor limits
  • Proactive performance baselining — establishing and monitoring baselines so degradation is caught before it becomes a client-facing incident, not just reactive firefighting

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, proactively identifying performance, availability, and security risks before they become incidents
  • Advise clients on cloud database architecture, migration, and cost optimization across AWS and Azure (IaaS and PaaS)
  • Lead architecture design, disaster recovery planning, and capacity forecasting initiatives
  • Own the end-to-end database service lifecycle — backup strategy, HA/DR configuration, proactive tuning, and platform roadmap planning
  • Define and track service-level objectives (SLOs) for database availability and performance, and drive automated remediation for recurring failure patterns rather than manually resolving the same issue repeatedly
  • Lead root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews for major issues, translating findings into automation or process changes that prevent recurrence
  • Design and implement scalable database structures, including partitioning strategies and audit specifications
  • Develop and maintain deployment/rollback scripts and coordinate version updates across environments
  • Build automation (Python, PowerShell) for backup validation, monitoring, alerting, and reporting integrations (e.g., Power BI)
  • Migrate/support SSIS packages and SSAS cubes, and develop stored procedures for reporting
  • Collaborate directly with client technical teams and executive stakeholders, translating technical findings into business-relevant recommendations

raw.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesHighly skilled and experienced Automation Test Engineer with a strong background in both functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications built using OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
raw.description:
Responsibilities

Highly skilled and experienced Automation Test Engineer with a strong background in both functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications built using OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components (LWC). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise with automation tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Playwright, and AI-based testing tools. The position will play a critical role in ensuring quality across the development lifecycle. This role places a strong emphasis on in-sprint automation, enabling rapid feedback and continuous delivery within Agile teams. Additionally, the position involves API testing for complex insurance applications, using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate integrations and ensure seamless data flow across systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts for Salesforce applications using tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, and Playwright
  • Utilize AI capabilities for self-healing locators, test data generation, and root cause analysis
  • Utilize AI-powered testing tools to improve manual and functional testing efficiency by enabling automated test case generation based on business requirements and user workflows, capturing test evidence without manual intervention, auto-generating automation scripts wherever feasible, and intelligently identifying scenarios that require manual execution
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and QA team members to implement in-sprint automation, ensuring test coverage is aligned with sprint goals and delivered within sprint timelines
  • Perform manual and functional testing to validate new features, identify edge cases, and ensure comprehensive test coverage where automation is not feasible
  • Lead the planning and execution of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and API testing across multiple platforms and environments
  • Develop and execute API test cases using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate service integrations and data accuracy
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster feedback loops
  • Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work with development teams to resolve issues efficiently
  • Maintain and manage test environments, test data, and automation frameworks to support ongoing testing needs
  • Maintain the automation regression suites based on continuous enhancements or new features implemented
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to best practices in test automation and quality assurance
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: salesforce)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance with a strong focus on automation
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce testing (Salesforce Sales/Service/Experience Cloud/FSC)
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing platforms and generative AI tools used for test design, script generation, test maintenance, and defect analysis
  • Proficiency in automation tools and frameworks: Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Provar, Playwright
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: Salesforce)
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, testing types, and software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using Page Object Model (POM), data-driven, and hybrid framework approaches
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, JSON/XML payloads, OAuth authentication, and integration workflows
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps)
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and in-sprint automation practices
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Property and Casualty Insurance knowledge is a plus
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Zephyr
  • Experience with automating applications which are developed using Salesforce OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components would be a plus
  • Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Salesforce platform components including Flows, Validation Rules, Apex integrations, Profiles, Permission Sets, and security models is a plus

About Our Company

H.W. Kaufman Group is a powerful global network of companies dedicated to shaping the future of insurance. With thousands of dedicated professionals across an extensive network of over 60 offices around the world, we lead by offering innovative solutions that are at the forefront of the industry. We are privately owned and thus free from the influence of Wall Street. This allows us the ability to adapt to constantly fluctuating market conditions. From brokerage, underwriting, and real estate to claims, loss control and risk management services, our depth of services is unrivaled.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The H.W. Kaufman Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other status or condition protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

In addition, Kaufman will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Lead neutral legal and adjudicative support for CMS Office of Hearings activities, primarily Medicare Advantage Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) appeals. Research complex issues, synthesize multidisciplinary findings, and draft clear, defensible recommendations and proposed decisions for the CMS Hearing Officer. This is a part time position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review RADV appeal requests, briefs, motions, hearing records, and supporting documentation.
  • Research and apply statutes, regulations, CMS guidance, policies, procedures, and precedent.
  • Draft and review legal memoranda, orders, notices, recommendations, and proposed decisions.
  • Evaluate jurisdictional, procedural, and substantive issues and escalate material risks or deficiencies.
  • Integrate legal, medical, coding, and case-management findings into neutral, well-supported recommendations.
  • Provide final quality review, guide legal support staff, coordinate with CMS and project leadership, and maintain compliant case records.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in legal studies, paralegal studies, health policy, public administration, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible legal, regulatory, compliance, administrative appeals, or healthcare policy experience.
  • 5+ years drafting or substantively reviewing legal briefs, memoranda, recommendations, proposed decisions, orders, opinions, or comparable analytical work products.
  • Knowledge of Medicare or Medicaid law, healthcare appeals, managed care, or regulatory oversight.
  • Demonstrated strength in complex legal research, neutral analysis, decision writing, quality review, communication, organization, and deadline management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and legal, document, or case-management systems; ability to obtain required suitability and system access.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active bar admission in a U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Experience with administrative hearings, appeals, adjudications, decision writing, or judicial clerkship work.
  • Experience supporting federal hearing officers or administrative law judges.
  • Direct experience with CMS appeals, Medicare Advantage, RADV, or healthcare regulatory adjudication.

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Plans and executes sales targets and activities in a specified region for the portfolio of a unit in order to increase sales with all kinds of potential customers and to achieve defined commercial targets. This role offers a competitive compensation package, including a target annual variable incentive based on performance and applicable plan terms.

We are currently looking for an ambitious Regional Informatics Sales Executive (RISE) in the West, South-West, Mid-South and Northeast to join our Informatics business within Point of Care.


As a Regional Informatics Sales Specialist you will be responsible for:

  • Develop and execute a regional sales strategy focused specifically on middleware, connectivity, and interoperability solutions.
  • Drive new business development and expand existing accounts within hospitals, health systems, and laboratory networks.
  • Sell middleware platforms that support:
    • Instrument-to-LIS connectivity
    • LIS-to-EMR/EHR integration
    • Data normalization and transformation
    • Rules-based autoverification and workflow automation
    • Interface engine and API-based interoperability solutions
  • Identify and engage key stakeholders including CIOs, CMIOs, Laboratory Directors, Pathologists, IT Integration Managers, and Clinical Informatics teams.
  • Conduct in-depth technical and workflow discovery to understand integration gaps, interface failures, and operational inefficiencies.
  • Translate complex middleware capabilities into clear clinical, operational, and financial value propositions.
  • Deliver technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and architecture-level discussions in collaboration with pre-sales engineers.
  • Manage a robust sales pipeline using CRM tools, ensuring accurate forecasting and opportunity progression.
  • Lead complex, multi-system sales cycles involving IT, laboratory operations, procurement, and executive leadership.
  • Coordinate with implementation and integration teams to ensure smooth transition from sale to deployment.
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements in collaboration with legal and finance teams.
  • Monitor competitive middleware platforms, interface engines, and emerging interoperability standards.
  • Represent the organization at healthcare IT, laboratory, and interoperability-focused conferences and events.

Required skills to have for the success of this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Must have 5-8 years of successful sales experience in healthcare IT, laboratory informatics, and/or enterprise software.
  • Direct experience selling middleware, interface engines, integration platforms, or interoperability solutions.
  • Proven success managing complex, technical, enterprise-level sales cycles.
  • Strong ability to engage both technical (IT/integration) and clinical stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience working with CRM systems.
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned region.

Preferred skills:

  • Master’s degree in Business, Healthcare Informatics, or related field.
  • Experience with laboratory middleware platforms, interface engines, or healthcare integration engines (e.g., HL7 engines, API gateways).
  • Strong understanding of HL7, FHIR, ASTM, and other healthcare data standards.
  • Experience integrating laboratory instruments with LIS systems in physician lab, hospital or reference lab environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based integration architectures and hybrid on-prem/cloud deployments.
  • Background working with IDNs, academic medical centers, large hospital systems, or national reference laboratories.

The base pay range for this position is: $89,600 - $123,200

Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

If this is a commission eligible position the commission eligibility will be in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan. Commissions are based on individual performance and/or company performance

Overview

Carenet Health is not authorized to hire in certain states due to internal business considerations: AZ, CA, CO, ME, NE, NJ, NY, NV, OR, WA, MD, RI, WV, AK, HI, CT, DE, VT, or Puerto Rico

Start date: 10/29/2026

At Carenet, we foster collaboration, creativity and innovation. Our promises to our team members include empowering growth through trust, opportunity and accountability. We are looking for people who want to work with an entrepreneurial spirit and deliver market-leading performance!

If you are passionate about healthcare and supporting patients with their healthcare needs, empathetic, patient focused and enjoys interacting with patients, patient representatives, providers, pharmacies and more, then this may be the position for you. Did we mention this was a remote, work from home position?

Compensation & Benefits

At Carenet Health, we value the expertise and dedication of our team members, and we are committed to offering an appealing compensation package. The wage for the Customer Service Rep role is $16.00 per hour.

In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off (PTO) and holidays, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), employee wellness programs, and career development opportunities.

What you will do:

The Health Advisor serves as a key point of contact within Hoag’s Centralized Patient Service Center, supporting patients with scheduling and coordination across multiple service lines, including CT, MRI, mammography and bone density (DEXA), X-ray and ultrasound, laboratory, nuclear medicine, pulmonary, vascular, surgery and labor & delivery, as well as physician scheduling and general radiology call support.

In this role, the Health Advisor delivers a compassionate, efficient, and accurate patient experience while managing high-volume inbound interactions in a remote contact center environment. Responsibilities include scheduling, rescheduling, confirming appointments, addressing patient inquiries, and documenting all interactions in accordance with client protocols, HIPAA standards, and service expectations.

  • Manage inbound and outbound patient interactions to support scheduling and coordination of diagnostic imaging services.
  • Schedule, reschedule, cancel, and confirm patient appointments across diagnostic imaging and specialty service lines, including but not limited to CT, MRI, mammography/bone density (DEXA), X-ray/ultrasound, laboratory, nuclear medicine, pulmonary, vascular, surgery and labor & delivery, radiology and nuclear medicine physician scheduling, and main call support.
  • Respond to patient inquiries regarding imaging services, appointment availability, preparation instructions, verifying insurance, and general service information.
  • Accurately document all patient interactions, appointment details, and updates in the appropriate systems and CRM platforms.
  • Review patient orders, referrals, and provider instructions to ensure appointments are scheduled according to established guidelines and protocols.
  • Navigate multiple systems simultaneously (e.g., scheduling platforms, CRM tools, and communication systems) while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
  • Communicate professionally with patients, providers, and internal teams to coordinate care and resolve scheduling needs.
  • Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and active listening skills while supporting patients throughout the scheduling process.
  • Follow established workflows, call flows, and knowledge resources when handling patient interactions and service requests.
  • Identify patient needs and take appropriate actions to ensure concerns are resolved, and service expectations are met.
  • Maintain productivity and quality standards in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to HIPAA regulations and all privacy and security standards.
  • Participate in required training programs, including modality-based training for imaging services.
  • Engage in coaching sessions and apply feedback to improve performance and service delivery.
  • Maintain consistent attendance and schedule adherence to support operational goals.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of six months of experience in a healthcare contact center, patient access, or customer service environment preferred, with hands-on experience scheduling medical appointments within a healthcare organization—preferably supporting diagnostic imaging, specialty care, or multi-department scheduling is required.
  • Required Work From Home experience in a private, secure, and distraction-free environment while maintaining full compliance with HIPAA and company data privacy standards.
  • Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Demonstrated understanding of and consistent adherence to contact center performance metrics (e.g., adherence, quality, and service levels), in alignment with scorecard standards and Remote Work Agreement (RWA) expectations.
  • Ability to adhere to assigned schedules within program operating hours, demonstrating reliability, punctuality, and consistent attendance. Must be flexible to adjust shifts, swap coverage, and support overtime based on business needs, while maintaining timely and professional communication regarding schedule changes or absences.
  • Ability to manage multiple systems and tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established protocols and workflows.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to research and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Basic computer proficiency including experience with Windows-based systems and applications such as Outlook, Teams, and CRM or scheduling platforms.
  • Ability to type a minimum of 40 words per minute.

Flexibility to work assigned schedules, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as required

Compensation & Benefits

At Carenet Health, we value the expertise and dedication of our team members, and we are committed to offering an appealing compensation package. The wage for the Customer Service Rep role is $16.00 per hour.

In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off (PTO) and holidays, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), employee wellness programs, and career development opportunities.

Additional Information

Note: Completion of assessments may be required before an applicant can move forward. Completing assessments must be done independently. Any discovery of unauthorized completion, whether during or after the hiring process, will result in disqualification or termination.

Carenet Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please note that we are not accepting resumes for this position from external staffing agencies or recruiters. To be considered for this role, please submit your application directly through our official career portal.

The Specialist partners with the Intellectual Property Office (IPO), Correlation Evaluation (CorEval), project managers, production coordinators, and translation and publishing stakeholders to review and facilitate the approval of hymns for IP clearance.

The ideal candidate has legal or paralegal experience, enjoys research, communicates effectively, demonstrates exceptional attention to detail, and is comfortable using project management software and workflow systems. Because the role includes reviewing international and foreign-language materials, the successful candidate must be able to analyze complex information, exercise sound judgment, and coordinate effectively with internal partners.

Overview

Flexible Worker Contract 

Location:Remote

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

T Level Technical Qualification in Health (Occupational Specialism - Supporting the Adult Nusing Team)

As an Examiner, you’ll use your subject knowledge to mark external assessments and submit results throughout the summer 2027 marking window, helping to ensure learners receive fair, consistent and accurate results.

If you’re an Adult Nursing, Nursing or Health and Social Care teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor, this is a great opportunity to put your expertise to use and make a valuable contribution to the assessment of learners.

Marking window dates are subject to change and will be communicated throughout the process should you be successful.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Following and maintaining the standard set by the Chief Examiner, applying the mark scheme consistently and accurately
  • Reporting suspected malpractice or safeguarding concerns to the Assessment Delivery team
  • Attending examiner standardisation and other meetings as required – standardisation events will be run remotely and scheduled for weekdays between the hours of 9.00am-5.00pm prior to the start of the marking window
  • Maintaining the confidentiality of NCFE assessment materials, learner evidence and learner details, and report any breaches to the Assessment Delivery team 

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:  

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in adult nursing or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent teaching experience at Level 3 or above in an adult nursing related subject, or significant recent occupational experience within the sector
  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.  

Shape real change with an NCFE career 

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.   

Want to know more? Take a look at our website 

How to apply 

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.  

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

 Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement 

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.  

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Senior Program Manager, Mission Advancement Operations.

This position can be home-based.

Mission Advancement is a 100+ person department accountable for outright and deferred major and principal gift revenue development from individuals, as well as for foundation giving and government funding. Mission Advancement Operations provides the strategies, programs, processes, systems, and workforce capabilities that enable the department to achieve its annual goals and advance its long-term transformation. Mission Advancement revenue has doubled during the past five years through the combined strength of donor- and volunteer-facing teams and strategically designed operational infrastructure. We intend to build on this trajectory through integrated processes and systems, workforce development, and emerging technologies that strengthen future capabilities.

Mission Advancement Operations provides revenue-generation infrastructure and business operations services. Revenue-generation infrastructure includes individual and foundation prospect research, portfolio management, lead-generation and content marketing communications, donor and professional advisor engagement, operation of the American Heart Association Professional Advisor Network, proposal development, and resource management. Business operations services include budget management, talent development and training, performance management, gift processing, reporting and compliance submissions. The division also manages a robust technology portfolio comprising an average of 10–15 active projects across these service areas.

Responsibilities

Reporting to the National Vice President, Development Operations, the Senior Program Manager, Mission Advancement Operations leads planning, implementation, and performance reporting for a broad portfolio of operational and transformation priorities. The role provides the structure, coordination, and execution discipline needed to advance work across the full scope of Mission Advancement Operations and to communicate progress, outcomes, and return on investment.

This position translates operational vision, priorities, and assignments into structured implementation plans, delivery, and measurable results. While project management and communication are critical strengths of the individual in the position, this is a delivery role, responsible not only for planning and coordinating but also for getting work done.

The position may supervise up to one staff member and is accountable for establishing the program management structure and execution discipline required to advance the operational and transformation portfolio.

Advance Operational Excellence

  • Translate operational vision and priorities into clear and actionable program plans, workstreams, milestones, ownership, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Develop and manage the portfolio of Mission Advancement Operations goals and projects. Maintain visibility into progress, risks, decisions, outcomes, and staff contributions across the portfolio; elevate matters requiring National Vice President action or direction; and drive timely decision-making and follow-through.
  • Lead cross-functional planning and implementation for annual and multi-year operational priorities in partnership with the National Vice President, Operations Leadership Team, and other stakeholders. Facilitate planning and solution development, establish roadmaps and project plans, clarify participant roles, maintain action-item accountability, monitor progress, and recommend corrective action when needed.
  • Ensure completed projects and initiatives transition successfully to operational owners with appropriate documentation, controls, and sustainment plans.

Advance Operational Technology and Transformation

  • Manage day-to-day delivery across the technology project portfolio. Coordinate follow-up with Business Technology implementers, monitor milestones and dependencies, resolve execution barriers, and provide the National Vice President with clear updates on progress, exceptions, decisions, and escalation needs.
  • Work closely with the VP and operations leadership colleagues to implement the ELEVATE vision for technology-enabled transformation.
  • Ensure the identification, documentation and establishment of the semantic layer needed for future transformative technology projects across Mission Advancement.
  • Establish and maintain Mission Advancement agent register
  • Coordinate approved artificial intelligence, automation, Copilot, and agent-enabled initiatives including support for engagement related to workforce upskilling.

Workforce Effectiveness and Change Enablement

  • Manage the Mission Advancement onboarding and offboarding process and resources, including the strategic content development of role-specific plan templates, development and maintenance of Mission Advancement subject matter expert presentations, coordination with national HR onboarding, and engagement/notification of stakeholders.
  • Project manage the implementation of prioritized improvements arising from employee engagement surveys and other department feedback.
  • Plan and oversee Mission Advancement department meetings and Operations Division meetings. Develop agendas with leadership input; coordinate presentations, executive talking points, production, and stakeholder readiness; and ensure decisions and follow-up actions are documented and advanced.
  • Prepare for and oversee production of the annual Mission Advancement Awards, Operations Division awards and related processes and materials.
  • Coordinate approved professional development initiatives for Mission Advancement, including implementation planning, stakeholder communication, participation support, and progress tracking, as directed by the National Vice President.

Staff Supervision

  • May supervise, coach, and develop up to one staff member.
  • Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, development objectives, and workload alignment.
  • Delegate appropriate project coordination, documentation, reporting support, meeting logistics, and action tracking while maintaining accountability for timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Maintain an operating model that distinguishes senior program management responsibilities from project coordination support.

Division Performance Measurement

  • Partner with the National Vice President and Operations leaders to establish a layered portfolio of key performance indicators across the division’s scope. Track and analyze results, develop clear reports and infographics, and validate data with workstream owners to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent reporting.
  • Alert to opportunities, recommendations for action, and escalation points for the National Vice President.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum five (5) years of management experience in the nonprofit setting, to include project management, program management, campaign management, and/or P&L responsibility.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or projects from planning to execution to final reporting.
  • Experience translating a senior leader’s vision and priorities into implementation plans, coordinated workstreams, and measurable results.
  • Experience applying project management, operational improvement, and change enablement practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish structure, clarify ownership, manage dependencies, drive accountability, and advance work through completion.
  • Experience developing and using KPIs, project plans, dashboards, performance measures, status reports, and decision-support materials.
  • Experience with strategic business development and management related to technology projects.
  • Working knowledge of foundation giving, major and legacy gift development, and the infrastructure supporting this area of development operations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate work across teams in a hierarchical culture without relying on formal authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, GenAI, project management, and collaboration tools.
  • Experience supervising, coaching, or directing the work of a staff member.
  • Ability to travel up to 5%, including occasional overnight travel.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Training

  • Direct experience and/or working knowledge of lead generation marketing, prospect research, proposal development, and stewardship communications.
  • Experience or working knowledge of the financial and estate planning advisory industry.
  • Experience in a national nonprofit organization.
  • Hands-on experience supporting operational transformation, process automation, artificial intelligence, Copilot, agent-enabled workflows, CRM, data, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience coordinating onboarding, offboarding, professional development, employee engagement, or workforce activation programs.
  • Experience measuring adoption, efficiency, quality improvement, operational impact, and benefit realization.
