description: OverviewBerryDunn is seeking an experienced Senior Consultant, Medicaid Funding and Acquisition to join our Medicaid Practice Group within our Consulting Team.

raw.title: Senior Consultant, Medicaid Funding and Acquisition
raw.excerpt: OverviewBerryDunn is seeking an experienced Senior Consultant, Medicaid Funding and Acquisition to join our Medicaid Practice Group within our Consulting Team.
raw.description:
Overview

BerryDunn is seeking an experienced Senior Consultant, Medicaid Funding and Acquisition to join our Medicaid Practice Group within our Consulting Team. This position is planned to serve state Medicaid agency clients across the country and support engagements (primarily Delaware and Puerto Rico) focused on Medicaid financing, planning, procurement, and implementation activities.

You will support engagement leads and project teams that assist state Medicaid agencies with Advanced Planning Document (APD) narrative and budget development, Outcomes-Based Procurement (OBP) planning and execution, stakeholder coordination, research, and related advisory services. In this role, you will take ownership of assigned tasks, work packages, and smaller workstreams; develop and review client-ready deliverables; coordinate with junior team members when needed; and help clients navigate Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) funding and procurement expectations under the direction of engagement/project leadership.

The ideal candidate brings strong Medicaid consulting, writing, analytical, and client-service skills, with the ability to operate independently within defined assignments while escalating questions, risks, and decisions appropriately. Successful candidates will be comfortable managing multiple tasks, facilitating portions of meetings, synthesizing complex information, identifying risks and dependencies, and producing high-quality deliverables that support Medicaid program modernization and related funding and acquisition efforts.

Travel Expectations: This role may require up to 25% travel to support client engagements, including on-site meetings, planning sessions, procurement activities, and key project milestones for assigned state or territorial Medicaid clients.

You Will

  • Support the development of APD narratives, Medicaid Detailed Budget Tables, budget documentation, and other CMS submission materials, taking ownership of assigned sections or work packages.
  • Support engagement/project leads by researching and applying APD processes, Medicaid funding strategies, cost allocation considerations, and federal compliance expectations.
  • Support OBP activities, including procurement planning, requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, document development, vendor question responses, evaluation support, and related acquisition activities.
  • Develop, review, and refine client deliverables, presentations, reports, meeting materials, procurement documents, and supporting artifacts.
  • Facilitate client, vendor, and internal team meetings; communicate findings, recommendations, risks, and decisions clearly to project leadership and client stakeholders.
  • Manage assigned tasks, small workstreams, timelines, action items, risks, issues, decisions, deliverables, and milestones in coordination with the engagement lead or project manager.
  • Coordinate with project teams to research, analyze, and synthesize Medicaid policy, procurement, funding, operational, and technical information.
  • Coordinate with and provide task-level guidance to junior team members when appropriate, including reviewing assigned work products and providing feedback for quality and consistency.
  • Identify opportunities to improve APD, procurement, and project delivery methodologies and contribute to practice-wide knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in firm-wide initiatives, including internal process improvement, staff development, and business development efforts.

You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in a related field; five years of applicable experience may be substituted for degree requirements.
  • 5-10 years of experience supporting Medicaid agencies, health and human services programs, public sector consulting, procurement, project management, or related advisory services.
  • 3-5 years of experience developing or reviewing clear, concise, and professional written deliverables, including APDs, reports, proposals, procurement documents, policies, business documents, or similar materials.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience and a desire to step into a service and team-oriented leadership role.
  • Demonstrated understanding of CMS APD and procurement requirements, Medicaid funding mechanisms, budgeting, procurement and contracting life cycles, and federal compliance standards.
  • Strong task management, organizational, analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently advance assigned responsibilities while coordinating with project leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize competing deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced client-service environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings and communicate with clients, vendors, project teams, and executive-level stakeholders.
  • High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.
  • Interest in mentoring junior staff and contributing to practice development, internal process improvement, and business development activities.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $120,000-$140,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

raw.description:
Overview

At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

Job Summary: The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading complex, multi‑workstream client engagements with a strong emphasis on delivery excellence, resource optimization, and engagement economics. This role partners closely with service leaders, consultants, and client leadership to ensure projects and programs are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate governance, while navigating ambiguity, evolving scope, and imperfect data.

Work Location

This role is open to remote candidates. Due to the geographic distribution of our team and client base, we are primarily focused on candidates located within the Central or Eastern time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working primarily within these time zones to support collaboration with team members and clients. Occasional travel is required (approximately 15%), primarily within the Midwest and East Coast regions.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

Project & Engagement Leadership

  • Lead large, complex projects and portfolios with multiple workstreams, actively managing scope, schedule, budget, risk, and interdependencies
  • Own budget‑to‑actual performance, including forecasting, reconciliation, burn analysis, ETC, utilization, and margin impact
  • Translate delivery risk into financial, operational, and audit‑relevant language; facilitate and lead executive steering committees and governance forums
  • Define, implement, and enforce stage gates, delivery standards, and governance models across engagements

Delivery Enablement

  • Use delivery data and operational metrics (burn, ETC, utilization, risk heatmaps) to drive informed decision‑making
  • Develop and enhance delivery methodologies, templates, and best practices to improve consistency and scalability
  • Build executive‑ready dashboards and narratives from incomplete or evolving data; present program status, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders

Tools, Data, and Process Optimization

  • Create and maintain project and program toolkits to enable time, budget, and risk management.
  • Lead or support the implementation and optimization of PSA / PPM tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Mavenlink, OpenAir, Adaptive, Planview)
  • Lead detailed resource planning, capacity planning, and portfolio prioritization across competing initiatives
  • Ensure alignment between SDLC, change management, access controls, and governance frameworks

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 7+ years of project management experience at a professional services firm or 10+ years of industry project management experience with 1+ year at a professional services firm
  • Proven experience leading multi‑workstream programs
  • Demonstrated ownership of engagement economics, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance
  • Experience leading resource management, including capacity planning and portfolio prioritization
  • Experience operating in environments with ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and shifting scope
  • Strong understanding of SDLC frameworks and ability to train and enable teams
  • About 15% of travel to client locations in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PgMP or PMP certification
  • Experience aligning SDLC, change management, and access controls.
  • Working knowledge of ERP platforms and delivery of ERP or large technology programs
  • Familiarity with COBIT, ITIL, and GAAP concepts

Benjamin Dzanic, from our recruiting team, will be guiding you through this process. Visit his LinkedIn page to connect!

Additional Details

Additional Details:

Wipfli is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All candidates will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identify, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Wipfli is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or participate in our recruiting process, please send us an email at .

Wipfli values fair, transparent, and competitive compensation, considering each candidate's unique skills and experiences. The estimated base pay range for this role is $117,000-158,000, with offers typically not made at the maximum, allowing for future salary increases. The actual salary at the time of offer depends on business related factors like location, skills, experience, training/education, licensure, certifications, business needs, current associate pay, and relevant employment laws.

Individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, subject to participation rules and based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual and Firm performance.

Wipfli cares about our associates and offers a variety of benefits to support their well-being. Highlights include 8 health plan options (both HMO & PPO plans), dental and vision coverage, opportunity to enroll in HSA with potential Firm contribution and an Employee Assistance Program. Other benefits include firm-sponsored basic life and short and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) savings plan & profit share as well as Firm matching contribution, well-being incentive, education & certification assistance, flexible time off, family care leave, parental leave, family formation benefits, cell phone reimbursement, and travel rewards. Voluntary benefit offerings include critical illness & accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, legal, long-term care, pet insurance, ID theft protection, and supplemental life/AD&D. Eligibility for all benefits programs is dependent on annual hours expectation, position status/level and location.

"Wipfli" is the brand name under which Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC and its respective subsidiary entities provide professional services. Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC (and its respective subsidiary entities) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. Wipfli LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients, and Wipfli Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. Wipfli Advisory LLC and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

raw.title: Integration Specialist
raw.excerpt: OverviewHR Acuity’s Professional Services group is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Integration Specialist to join our team.
raw.description:
Overview

HR Acuity’s Professional Services group is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Integration Specialist to join our team. This role is pivotal in working with our customers during and after implementation, ensuring seamless integration setup, technical expertise, and optimizing integration performance, all of which directly impacts customer satisfaction and HR Acuity’s success. You will collaborate closely with internal teams, including Product Management and Engineering, to influence the development of new tooling and raise/resolve technical issues. Additionally, you will provide training and support to our customer-facing teams, ensuring they are well-equipped to assist clients with integration-related matters.

What this job is
  • A customer-facing role working directly with external clients and owning the communication directly with customers and their IT teams.
  • A project management role, carrying a book of roughly 15 to 20 integration projects at once and driving each to resolution.
  • Hands-on technical work: responsible for data migrations, HRIS changes, and standard/custom integrations.
  • Enterprise API integration work (REST, SOAP, SFTP, webhooks) connecting HR Acuity to systems like HRIS, CRM, and ERP, including for the company's biggest customers.
  • A translator role, turning customer business requirements into technical configurations and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
What this job is not
  • Not an engineering role. The person will not write code.
  • Not a pure back-office or heads-down technical seat. Customer communication is more than half the job.
  • Not a support ticket queue. Support backgrounds can qualify, but only if the candidate has managed projects and done more advanced customer and backend work.

About HR Acuity®At HR Acuity®, we empower our team to #BeBold — embracing innovation and new challenges. We give you the tools to #WorkSmarter and foster the collaboration that makes us #BetterTogether. If you're excited to be part of our growth story, we'd love to chat.About Us: HR Acuity® is the leading provider of employee relations case management and investigation software. We help organizations standardize how workplace issues are reported, documented, and investigated, and our data-driven approach helps clients and partners build trusted, inclusive cultures where employees feel safe.This is an #All-In Zone. We're a fast-growing, innovative company led by a female founder and CEO, and being all-in is the norm here. From the top down, we bring our best every day — fueled by passion for our mission and culture — and we look for teammates who want to do the same.At the same time, we're deeply committed to an inclusive, diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued and respected. We believe in creating an environment where everyone can show up as their authentic self and thrive. If this sounds like you, keep reading.

Click here to learn more about our values and benefits

Please note that for this position, we are only accepting direct applications. Submissions from agencies will not be considered.

The Opportunity

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical setup and integrations configuration for new and existing HR Acuity customers, ensuring all technical requirements are met during the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure a world-class customer experience by providing clear communication, technical expertise, proactive project management.
  • Facilitate and manage the migration of customer data into the HR Acuity platform.
  • Assist Sales and Customer Success teams with technical scoping calls to ensure prospects and customers are properly supported.
  • Translate customer business requirements into technical solutions and configurations.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, providing input based on customer and technical experience to inform upcoming releases.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to identify and report recurring integration challenges.
  • Provide consultative guidance using established best practices to increase customer adoption and drive positive customer outcomes.
  • Scope and document new and existing technical processes/requirements in collaboration with customers and internal teams.
  • Manage and drive special projects and initiatives as assigned by Manager.

What We Offer:

  • A mission‑driven culture that prioritizes people, integrity, and continuous improvement.
  • The opportunity to help shape a growing integrations program in a high‑impact, high‑visibility role.
  • Collaboration with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to influence strategy and product evolution.
  • A supportive, flexible work environment with a strong focus on work/life balance.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Professional development opportunities, including access to certifications, training resources, and cross‑functional learning.

What Does Success Look Like?

  • Integrations and migrations are delivered accurately and on time, with exceptional customer satisfaction scores.
  • Professional Services, Sales and Customer Success teams rely on you as a trusted subject‑matter expert, resulting in smoother pre‑sales and onboarding cycles.
  • Recurring integration challenges decrease due to your collaboration with Product & Engineering.
  • Internal teams feel confident and enabled through the process documentation you deliver.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with integrations in a technical or implementation-focused role.
  • Track record of working directly with customers, ensuring a positive and effective integration experience.
  • Background in API integrations and enterprise system connections (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, SFTP, webhooks).
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Sales.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Experience in developing technical documentation and training.
  • Familiarity with CRM, ERP, HCM/HRIS, ATS, and other enterprise software ecosystems (e.g., Workday, ADP, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors, Salesforce).
  • Experience with integration/iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi) is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Perks and Benefits

Compensation: The pay range for this position is expected to be between $88,919 to $115,732 however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized, non-discriminatory factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus. Additionally, full-time employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits program, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) retirement plan, life and disability insurance coverages, and other benefits the company may offer from time to time.

Benefits:

  • Stay healthy and happy with our comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans.
    • You can also choose from FSA or HSA options to suit your needs.
  • Save for your future with our 401K plan that matches your contributions.
  • Enjoy paid leave for various life events, such as sickness, disability, or parenthood.
  • Own a piece of the company with our #Allin Shares Program.
  • Company paid holidays, birthday day off, closed 4th of July week and December holiday week and 8 hours of volunteer time.
  • Half day summer Fridays* and half day first Fridays* to catch up on work, personal development, or an afternoon off.

Perks:

  • Take a break from work with our unlimited PTO policy to refresh and recharge.
  • Company paid holidays, birthday day off, closed 4th of July week and December holiday week, half day summer Fridays* and half day first Fridays*, and 8 hours of volunteer time.
  • Own a piece of the company with our #Allin Shares Program.
  • Earn extra cash by referring qualified candidates to join our team.
  • Access professional and personal support through our employee assistance program.
  • Work from anywhere with our remote work environment that fosters collaboration and creativity.*
  • Join a fun and energetic team that values your suggestions and new ideas.
  • Receive a competitive salary and meaningful opportunities for growth.

Learning and Development

  • Onboarding: Learn the basics of your role, the company culture, and the expectations from your manager and team. Get familiar with the tools, systems, and processes that you will use in your daily work. Receive feedback and guidance from your mentor and peers.
  • Manager training: Develop the skills and competencies to lead, motivate, and empower your team. Learn how to communicate effectively, delegate tasks, set goals, provide feedback, and resolve conflicts. Enhance your emotional intelligence, coaching, and mentoring abilities.
  • Leadership training: Grow your leadership potential and influence within the organization. Learn how to inspire and align others with the company vision, mission, and values. Strengthen your strategic thinking, decision making, and problem-solving skills. Expand your network and collaboration with other leaders across functions and levels.
  • Industry training: Stay updated on the latest trends, best practices, and innovations in the Employee Relations industry. Gain insights from experts and thought leaders in the field. Apply your learning to improve your performance, quality, and efficiency.

* Based upon business needs

raw.description:
Summary

Fire Creek Services Company, an All Native Group company, is seeking a Cybersecurity / RMF Lead to lead security authorization for a cloud-hosted maintenance management platform, including IL4/IL5 control implementation, RMF/ATO evidence, CUI protection and NIST SP 800-171 compliance, continuous monitoring and incident reporting. This is an immediate opening.

Essential Functions

  • Prepare and manage the security authorization package (SSP, POA&M and control evidence) in coordination with the Mission Owner and Authorizing Official.
  • Implement identity, access and data controls (CAC/PIV federation, role separation, audit records and secrets management).
  • Define operational technology (OT) segmentation for sensors, gateways and building controllers.
  • Run vulnerability management, continuous monitoring and required incident reporting.
  • Maintain NIST SP 800-171 evidence and support CMMC assessments.
  • Deliver security awareness content for technicians and administrators.
  • Run vulnerability scans on a regular, defined schedule and track remediation to closure.
  • Review audit logs and security alerts and investigate suspicious activity.
  • Perform security impact analysis on proposed system changes.

Competencies

  • RMF/ATO package development
  • DoD cybersecurity controls
  • Risk assessment and continuous monitoring
  • Clear security communication and training
  • Audit log review and threat analysis

Supervisory Responsibility

None required for this position

Work Environment

Remote or office-based, computer-focused work, with periodic on-site travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lb.
  • Occasional walking of buildings and mechanical spaces during on-site security walkdowns.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

Full-time and part-time positions available. Typical hours are Monday through Friday, daytime.

Travel

Periodic travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky, for authorization meetings and operational technology walkdowns.

Experience

  • 7+ years of DoD cybersecurity experience.
  • 3+ years leading RMF/ATO packages (eMASS) through authorization.
  • Authored ATO packages that were granted.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Government or equivalent cloud security tooling.

Preferred:

  • NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC assessments.
  • Army authorization processes.
  • OT/IoT security (NIST SP 800-82).
  • Experience with ACAS/Nessus vulnerability scanning and DISA STIGs.
  • Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk).
  • Experience working on Department of Defense (DoD) installations, contracts or programs is a plus.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems or a related field.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • CISSP or CISM (DoD 8140 IAM Level II/III) required.
  • CompTIA Security+ required at minimum.
  • Must be able to pass a background check and obtain installation access.

Drug Free Workplace

All Native Group is a Drug Free Workplace. It is our policy that all new hires must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screen as a condition of employment. In addition, all employees are subject to random drug screens throughout the term of their employment with All Native Group.

Security Clearance

None

AAP/EEO Statement 

All Native Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. However, preference may be extended to persons of Indian descent in accordance with applicable laws.

About Ho-Chunk, Inc. & All Native Group

raw.title: Program Manager I, El Niño Preparedness EMPOWER/RAPID
raw.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Program Manager I will provide program management, technical, and coordination support to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen El Niño preparedness and readiness for rapid, partner-led emergency response.
raw.description:
Job Summary

The Program Manager I will provide program management, technical, and coordination support to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen El Niño preparedness and readiness for rapid, partner-led emergency response. The position will support implementation of preparedness activities across priority countries and hotspots, helping translate hazard, vulnerability, market, operational, and partner-capacity information into practical readiness actions, quality program designs, and activation-ready response plans.

Working under the guidance of the Program Manager II and in coordination with technical, MEAL, supply chain, finance, safeguarding, and operations colleagues, the Program Manager I will accompany partners to complete priority preparedness deliverables, address program bottlenecks, test readiness arrangements, and maintain country-level materials that can be rapidly adapted when an EMPOWER/RAPID response is activated.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Support implementation of the El Niño preparedness workplans across assigned South America countries or hotspots in coordination with EMPOWER partners, country teams, RAPID counterparts, and technical and operational colleagues.
  • Maintain detailed activity plans, deliverable trackers, meeting records, and follow-up actions that connect program, MEAL, partnership, cash and voucher assistance, supply chain, finance, safeguarding, and operational readiness tasks.
  • Compile and synthesize available hazard, vulnerability, exposure, seasonal, and scenario information to help identify priority locations, population groups, likely needs, access constraints, and preparedness triggers for drought, floods, food insecurity, wildfires, and related El Niño impacts.
  • Support stakeholder and service mapping with partners, including government authorities, Caritas structures, humanitarian coordination bodies, community actors, technical services, financial service providers, and other response stakeholders.
  • Facilitate partner working sessions to develop or update country- and hotspot-specific contingency plans, response strategies, sector and modality options, targeting approaches, geographic priorities, and scalable response scenarios.
  • Gather technical inputs and support documentation of minimum program quality standards, intervention packages, eligibility and prioritization criteria, referral pathways, assistance quantities or transfer values, and safe adaptation or substitution rules.
  • Coordinate routine follow-up with supply chain and operations colleagues so proposed relief kits, in-kind assistance, and cash or voucher options reflect assessed needs, market capacity, cultural appropriateness, protection considerations, delivery feasibility, lead times, and cost drivers.
  • Incorporate validated market and logistics findings into program drafts, implementation schedules, modality recommendations, delivery sequencing, contingency options, and procurement inputs.
  • Support partner readiness for cash and voucher assistance, including participant-data requirements, accountability and complaints mechanisms, protection and inclusion measures, reconciliation processes, monitoring, and failed-payment follow-up.
  • Prepare and update activation-ready program materials, including rapid assessment tools, response concept drafts, targeting and registration approaches, implementation plans, staffing assumptions, budget inputs, procurement requests, risk registers, and donor narrative inputs.
  • Monitor assigned preparedness activities and any activated response tasks, flag delays or quality concerns, and support timely corrective action in line with CRS program quality principles and standards, donor requirements, and humanitarian good practice.
  • Work with MEAL and information-management colleagues to adapt practical indicators, data-collection tools, monitoring plans, feedback and response mechanisms, and learning questions for partner use.
  • Support integration of safeguarding, protection mainstreaming, gender, age, disability inclusion, accountability to affected populations, conflict sensitivity, and disaster risk reduction across assessments, designs, partner tools, simulations, and readiness plans.
  • Assist with partner readiness assessments and partner-specific action plans, ensuring that agreed actions, responsibilities, deadlines, support needs, risks, contingencies, and escalation points are clearly documented and followed up.
  • Organize and co-facilitate coaching sessions, workshops, simulations, tabletop exercises, and readiness tests, and prepare agendas, materials, participant records, and follow-up notes.
  • Provide day-to-day accompaniment and practical technical support to partners, adapting tools and guidance to partner priorities and promoting sustainable local ownership of preparedness systems.
  • Contribute to proposal development and resource mobilization through research, technical inputs, drafting, budget inputs, staffing assumptions, and compilation of supporting documentation.
  • Document decisions, lessons, tested approaches, readiness gaps, good practices, and recommendations, and maintain orderly shared files for knowledge management and handover.
  • Compile the final El Niño preparedness package for assigned countries or workstreams, including analyses, plans, tools, MEAL materials, partner action plans, training resources, ownership arrangements, and maintenance recommendations.

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Principal Consultant. The Principal Consultant is responsible for providing strategic advisory and consulting services to electric utilities supporting grid modernization initiatives with a primary focus on SCADA and EMS systems and a working knowledge of ADMS technologies. The role helps utilities develop grid modernization strategies, assess current operations, define future-state operating models, create business cases and technology roadmaps, develop technical and functional requirements, support technology procurement, evaluate software vendors, and provide trusted advisory services throughout implementation.

Responsibilities

Strategic Advisory Services

  • Conduct current-state assessments of utility operations and operational technology.
  • Facilitate stakeholder interviews and business process workshops.
  • Develop business cases, modernization strategies, and strategic recommendations.
  • Identify operational gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop implementation roadmaps and phased deployment strategies.

Grid Modernization Strategy

  • Assess utility operational technology maturity and modernization readiness.
  • Develop grid modernization strategies and technology roadmaps.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices.
  • Develop phased modernization and implementation strategies.
  • Advise utility leadership on technology investment priorities.
  • Develop business cases supporting modernization initiatives.

Business Process & Requirements Development

  • Lead workshops to document current and future-state business processes
  • Develop operational use cases supporting SCADA, EMS, and ADMS
  • Develop functional, technical, integration, cybersecurity, and non-functional requirements
  • Facilitate requirements prioritization with utility stakeholders
  • Ensure traceability between business objectives, use cases, requirements, demonstrations, and testing

Solution Architecture & Integration Advisory

  • Develop system architecture and integration strategies.
  • Develop interface requirements and integration approaches.
  • Review solution architectures and technical designs.
  • Conduct technical and architecture reviews.
  • Identify architecture, integration, and cybersecurity risks.
  • Align business requirements, technical requirements, and solution designs.
  • Collaborate with utility architects, vendors, and system integrators.

Procurement Advisory

  • Develop procurement strategies and acquisition plans.
  • Prepare Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and procurement documentation.
  • Develop evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and selection processes.
  • Lead vendor communications and Q&A activities.
  • Evaluate vendor proposals and technical responses.
  • Facilitate vendor demonstrations and proof-of-capability sessions.
  • Conduct vendor reference checks and due diligence.
  • Support contract negotiations and Statement of Work development.

Trusted Advisor Services

  • Serve as the owner's engineer during implementation.
  • Review solution architectures and technical deliverables.
  • Support governance and executive decision-making.
  • Monitor implementation progress.
  • Identify project risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Support testing and operational readiness.
  • Provide independent recommendations representing the utility's interests.

Client Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with utility executives, operational leadership, and project stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver executive presentations, steering committee updates, and strategic recommendations.
  • Facilitate executive workshops, planning sessions, and decision-making discussions.

Business Development Support

  • Support proposal development and client pursuits.
  • Develop reusable advisory methodologies, templates, and best practices.
  • Author technical white papers, articles, and thought leadership content.
  • Present at industry conferences, client workshops, and webinars.
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience supporting electric utility operational technology, including SCADA, EMS, ADMS, or related systems.
  • Experience should have been obtained through one or more of the following:
    • Electric utility consulting.
    • SCADA/EMS software vendor implementation, engineering, product management, or professional services organizations.
    • Electric utility engineering, system operations, operational technology (OT), transmission/distribution operations, or control center organizations.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

The senior BA suggests alternative approaches when appropriate. The Senior Business Analyst completely documents and explains use cases, and is able to suggest innovative solutions and best practices. The Senior BA works as a consultant to business units and technical teams to provide details on data requirements, functionality, integration and workflow needs, impacts to user interfaces, etc.Works within the SAFE Agile Delivery Methodology utilizing Atlassian JIRA and related tools

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

Tracks progress, documents decisions and business consensus performs follow-up communications, and documents resolutions to maintain project timelines. Analyzes possible impacts to the schedule for requested changes and coordinates with project management any impacts to the project timeline..

raw.description:
Overview

As VP Product, Interoperability, you will own and execute Cotiviti’s market strategy, product roadmap and commercial growth for health plan interoperability — extending our leading industry position and expanding our impact into broader payer / provider collaboration. You will bring unique insight into payer priorities, challenges, and blind spots; prioritize market needs; run competitive analysis; engage experts within and outside our organization; and lead product launches that expand our client value proposition and advance Cotiviti’s market position. Hands-on knowledge of payer administrative processes and payer / provider interoperability is essential, along with a genuine passion for solving hard problems and improving the healthcare system.

Reporting to the SVP of Product, you will have full ownership and accountability for product vision, definition, packaging, and market success across Cotiviti’s interoperability platform and commercial solutions. You will lead a matrixed, multi-level team, prioritizing and enhancing our existing solutions while delivering next-generation payer / provider collaboration solutions. You will bridge product vision, operational design, and commercial success — defining Cotiviti’s approach across the product lines you support. You will advocate and solution to ensure that all Cotiviti’s product offerings are FHIR native and leveraging our Interoperability Platform[CC1.1].

Cotiviti is evolving our market approach to become the utility layer for healthcare—reducing friction and significantly improving coordination across the system. In this role, you will play a key role in defining and executing Cotiviti’s expanded vision and improving healthcare. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a leader who combines deep product and market domain expertise, healthcare knowledge, business acumen, creativity, sound business judgment, and sharp analytical thinking.

Responsibilities

You will lead a cross-sectional, matrixed team, driving a customer- and sales-focused approach to building and launching new products, capabilities, and offerings into the marketplace. Here’s what you’ll own:

Vision

  • Leverage deep subject matter expertise to provide input into Cotiviti’s strategic plan across business units.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to develop targets for annual bookings, revenue, expenses, and client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a voice of the customer in new product management and development.

Strategic & Product Leadership

  • Develop multi-year roadmaps that provide deep insight into how we can become integral to the payer/provider collaboration journey, from provider workflows through post-adjudication.
  • Provide executive leadership for Cotiviti’s interoperability business, including product strategy, market strategy, operational strategy, revenue growth, client outcomes, and long-term business expansion.
  • Develop and influence corporate strategy related to interoperability, provider connectivity, healthcare data exchange, and payer-provider collaboration.
  • Serve as Cotiviti’s executive representative with key clients, strategic partners, regulators, industry consortiums, and market influencers.

Operational & Technical Leadership

  • Provide unique insight into the internal mechanics and challenges of payer platforms, processes, and administrative inefficiency, as well as payer/provider interoperability.

Process Improvement

  • Drive process re-engineering efforts leveraging AI and emerging technologies to drive transformative changes and improve the system.

Financial & Risk

  • Provide knowledge of how payers identify and eliminate administrative waste in claims processing, prior authorization, and other core operational processes through advanced data analytics tools, including areas of strength and gaps.
  • Leverage expertise in how payers currently perceive and manage costs with siloed or competitive approaches.
  • Own business performance, revenue growth, operating margin achievement, investment prioritization, and long-range financial planning for the interoperability business.

Compliance & Legal Oversight

  • Act as an authority for ensuring all products and operational workflows adhere to state and federal regulations.

Product Management

  • Lead a multidisciplinary organization through Directors, Senior Directors, and other senior leaders responsible for Product Management, Product Operations, Market Strategy, and Product Commercialization.

  • Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Marketing, Sales, Business Unit Operations, and R&D to develop and launch enhancements to the solutions portfolio.

  • Align with Business Unit and R&D processes, including SAFe Agile, as well as Product Management teams for delivering capabilities.

  • Define success criteria, review product performance against expectations, and facilitate or influence changes to the product portfolio to improve competitive position and optimize product performance.

Go to Market

  • Own the definition of customer experience for end-to-end solutions.

  • Lead completion and upkeep of Ready to Market (R2M) and Ready to Sell (R2S) tools, content, and training.

Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Product leadership team to establish and continuously improve processes for Product Management.

  • Assist Business Unit leaders in defining core processes and staffing needs to support new solutions.

Coaching

  • Champion the discipline of product development and product management practices, ensuring teams have the essential tools, processes, and skill sets to build product and service roadmaps that align with Cotiviti’s strategic and operational plans.

Growth

  • Define and execute three-to-five-year growth strategies, including market expansion, partnership strategies, acquisition integration opportunities, and innovation investments.

  • Be accountable for developing solutions that support profitability, efficiency, and growth targets.

  • Lead others in the design and development of new products.

  • Ask effective questions to fully understand client needs and engage others to solve those challenges. Assist in developing pricing strategies to maximize overall returns.

Quality

  • Work closely with technology, operations, and senior leadership to ensure releases are of the highest quality and the team can demonstrate progress against quality goals through clear metrics.

  • Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that employs best-in-class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.

  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal-setting process.

  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.

  • Be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience required; Master of Business Administration degree preferred.

  • 10 to 15+ years of progressive insurance and product experience, with a minimum of eight years in senior leadership roles overseeing matrixed teams.

  • 10+ years of experience, with increasing levels of responsibility and oversight, managing Product, Operations, or Professional Services.

  • 10+ years of experience preferred in the healthcare industry, with previous leadership experience in the appropriate domain, strong personnel management and presentation skills, and customer (internal/external) problem diagnostics and solution design capabilities.

  • Deep subject matter expertise in payer/provider interoperability and claims processing operations; direct experience managing claims operations or payer/provider interoperability for a health plan strongly preferred.

  • Deep knowledge of standards, the regulatory environment, and compliance considerations for interoperability required. Ability to measure and articulate the business value of compliance preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of claims management ecosystems and the ability to align R&D processes, such as SAFe Agile, with core operational needs.

  • Proactive leader with proven experience in strategic and tactical leadership and the ability to pursue and understand cutting-edge technologies.

  • The intellect and energy to excel in a complex and ever-changing environment, coupled with the poise and ability to act calmly in high-pressure, high-stress situations.

  • Proven experience in growth-oriented businesses in the healthcare information and analytics space, with strong competencies in developing and leading product development and strategy.

  • Excellent coach who is results-oriented and can build and motivate high-performance teams.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.

  • Completing tasks independently.

  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.

  • Maintaining focus.

  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

About ITT:

ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) is a diversified global leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions serving the flow, aerospace and defense, transportation, industrial, and energy markets. Through operational execution, innovation, and disciplined capital deployment, including strategic acquisitions such as SPX FLOW, ITT partners with its customers to deliver enduring solutions to the key industries that underpin our modern way of life.

Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, ITT has a market cap of roughly $20 billion and employs more than 15,000 people across 40 countries and serves customers in approximately 125 countries. Following the acquisition of SPX FLOW, the company is expected to generate $5.4 billion in annual revenue.

Our businesses are organized in three distinct segments, each based around our core engineering DNA:

Flow Technologies: A global leader in, providing a broad portfolio of pumps, valves, mixing and agitation equipment, heat transfer, homogenizers, separation, water and wastewater treatment, and engineered process solutions.Our leading brands include the iconic Goulds Pumps (with more than 175 years of history), Anhydro, APV, Bornemann, Bran+Luebbe, C’treat, Engineered Valves, Gerstenberg Schröder, Habonim, Johnson Pump, Lightnin, Philadelphia, Plenty, PRO Cast, Rheinhütte, Seital Separation, Stelzer, Svanehøj, Tigerholm, Uutechnic, VIDAR, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell.

Motion Technologies: A global leader in brake pads (ICE and electrified brake pads) and shock absorbers (energy absorption solutions) for transportation applications. Our leading brands include Friction Technologies, KONI and Axtone.

Connect and Control Technologies: A leader in critical applications for the aerospace, defense and industrial markets, including harsh environment connectors and control components. Our leading brands include ITT Cannon, Enidine, Aerospace Controls and kSARIA.

Position Summary

The Technical Sales Lead - Projects works in coordination with the Project Pursuit Lead to drive order growth by qualifying, developing, and securing capital project business. This role develops and maintains relationships with key stakeholders at targeted end users and EPCs through technical discussions and presentations focused on Engineered Valves capabilities and project support requirements. The position provides technical expertise, specification support, and project engagement activities to help secure project opportunities and drive business growth.

  • Sales and Technical Project Support

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders at targeted end users and EPCs.
  • Promote and sell Engineered Valves products and capabilities through technical expertise and product knowledge.
  • Technical Engagement and Specification Development

  • Review project specifications, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), and data sheets.
  • Conduct technical discussions and presentations with customers and project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with local sales personnel to conduct product information seminars for end users and EPC accounts.
  • Support distributors, field sales and inside sales personnel in customer engagements and order capture efforts.
  • Project Administration and Market Intelligence
  • Prepare reports, quotations, forecasts, and other administrative documentation.
  • Provide regular forecasts of potential sales volumes.
  • Communicate market trends and sales intelligence to management.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a technical field is preferred.
  • 5-7 years of outside technical sales experience is required. Experience selling valves, related products, or other capital equipment is preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, EPCs, OEMs, distributors, and internal stakeholders
  • Strong technical aptitude, organizational skills, and communication skills
  • Proven project coordination skills
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business and technical documents and prepare reports. Ability to performance specification reviews and technical evaluations.
  • Ability to effectively present information to customers, management, and other stakeholders
  • Ability to solve problems through data collection and establishing facts to draw conclusions and find solutions.
  • Strong presentation and relationship-building skills with a strong customer focus
  • Self-motivated and collaborative
  • MS Office proficiency - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

Overview

Flexible Worker Contract 

Location:Remote

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

T Level Technical Qualification in Health (Occupational Specialism - Supporting Therapy Teams)

As an Examiner, you’ll use your subject knowledge to mark external assessments and submit results throughout the summer 2027 marking window, helping to ensure learners receive fair, consistent and accurate results.

If you're a Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy or Allied Health teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor,this is a great opportunity to put your expertise to use and make a valuable contribution to the assessment of learners.

Marking window dates are subject to change and will be communicated throughout the process should you be successful.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Following and maintaining the standard set by the Chief Examiner, applying the mark scheme consistently and accurately
  • Reporting suspected malpractice or safeguarding concerns to the Assessment Delivery team
  • Attending examiner standardisation and other meetings as required – standardisation events will be run remotely and scheduled for weekdays between the hours of 9.00am-5.00pm prior to the start of the marking window
  • Maintaining the confidentiality of NCFE assessment materials, learner evidence and learner details, and report any breaches to the Assessment Delivery team 

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:  

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in therapy or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent teaching experience at Level 3 or above in a therapy related subject, or significant recent occupational experience within the sector
  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.  

Shape real change with an NCFE career 

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.   

Want to know more? Take a look at our website 

How to apply 

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.  

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

 Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement 

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.  

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The Data Science & Evaluation team is seeking a part-time Epidemiology Intern to support the Annual Heart Disease and Stroke Statistical Update. This position provides hands-on experience working with national surveillance and healthcare datasets, conducting epidemiologic analyses, producing statistical reports, and developing procedures that support high-quality, reproducible public health research.

The American Heart Association’s Internship Program provides college students an opportunity for hands-on experience in various facets for individuals interested in gaining work experience with a non-profit, voluntary health organization.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as training and support locally and through our National Center.#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Internship Overview:

  • Time Commitment: 20-25 hours per week
  • Internship Duration: 1/25/27-5/7/27​
  • Location: Remote
  • Salary: $23.00 per hour

Internship Outcomes:

Individuals participating in the internship program are provided with an opportunity to:

  • Gain important and practical job skills to be successful in a non-profit environment.
  • Opportunity to explore a career-path with a reputable voluntary health/service organization.
  • Complete an internship that enriches your academic and professional resume as well as enriching your personal life by making a difference in the lives of others.

Responsibilities

Tasks could include things like the following:

  • Extracting, analyzing and summarizing prevalence, mortality, and health care utilization, expenditure and outcome data using national data sets (i.e., NHANES, NHIS, CDC WONDER, HCUP, MEPS, etc.).
  • Assisting with the collection, management, analysis, and reporting of cardiovascular disease and stroke-related data.
  • Creating and updating statistical tables, figures, charts, and supporting documentation for scientific reports and publications.
  • Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs), analytic documentation, and process guides for data extraction, analysis, reporting, and quality assurance activities.
  • Collaborating with epidemiologists, data scientists, and scientific volunteers to respond to data requests and support annual publication activities.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Epidemiology, Public Health, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of statistical software such as cloud-based SAS and/or R required.
  • Interest in and commitment to working with chronic disease data and populations; this role focuses on chronic disease initiatives and is not centered on infectious disease research or programs.
  • Ability to conduct quantitative analyses, interpret public health data, develop written procedures and documentation, and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams to support high-quality, reproducible research and reporting efforts.
  • Experience using approved enterprise or closed-system AI tools to support data analysis, documentation, quality assurance, or scientific reporting is preferred.
  • Coursework or experience in epidemiologic methods, statistics, and population health research.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.
  • Effective oral, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment managing multiple priorities involving multiple entities.
  • Intermediate to excellent proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
  • Required Equipment: Reliable WiFi Connection.
  • Minimum availability of 20 hrs/wk, M-F between the hours of 8:30 am-5 pm CST.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship, now or in the future. For any roles working remotely, the work must also be performed inside the United States, not in a foreign country.

The job application window is expected to close: October 16, 2026.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation and Performance – Attracting talented, committed interns means offering competitive compensation, ongoing professional development and training, and an environment in which to work and grow. And we do.

We also provide access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost as a confidential program designed to assist employees and family members with personal issues that affect their relationships at home or at work.

Apply Today:So, are you ready to intern for the largest voluntary health organization dedicated to fighting heart disease, stroke, and other cardiovascular diseases?

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. raw.description:
Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking an experienced Microsoft Power Platform Specialist to join our team. This role will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting scalable business applications and automation solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform.

The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on expertise in Power Apps, including both Canvas and Model-Driven applications, along with experience across Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL Server, and Microsoft 365. This individual will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate complex requirements into intuitive, secure, and high-performing solutions that improve productivity and streamline business processes.

The Power Platform Specialist will serve as a technical subject matter expert, establishing development best practices, recommending solution approaches, and supporting applications throughout the full development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain custom business applications using Microsoft Power Apps, including Canvas and Model-Driven applications.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into scalable technical solutions using Microsoft Power Platform technologies.
  • Design intuitive, responsive, and user-focused application interfaces that provide a seamless user experience.
  • Develop and maintain data models using Microsoft Dataverse and integrate applications with SharePoint, SQL Server, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Design and implement automated business processes and workflows using Power Automate.
  • Integrate Power Apps with Power Automate, Microsoft 365 services, APIs, and external enterprise systems.
  • Develop advanced application functionality using Power Fx, JavaScript, SQL, and other applicable technologies.
  • Design and develop Power BI reports and dashboards that provide meaningful and actionable business insights.
  • Clean, transform, and model data from multiple sources to support reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Develop interactive and user-friendly Power BI visualizations and integrate reporting capabilities with Power Platform solutions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Power Platform, providing technical guidance on solution architecture, application design, scalability, security, performance, and development best practices.
  • Participate in requirements gathering sessions and collaborate with business users, product owners, developers, and other stakeholders to define solution requirements.
  • Manage solutions throughout the full application lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, and enhancement.
  • Troubleshoot application, workflow, integration, and performance issues and implement appropriate resolutions.
  • Establish and follow Power Platform development standards, governance practices, and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) processes.
  • Evaluate existing applications and processes and recommend enhancements that improve usability, performance, maintainability, and business value.
  • Incorporate user feedback and evolving business requirements into existing applications and solutions.
  • Stay current with Microsoft's Power Platform roadmap, emerging capabilities, and industry best practices and recommend opportunities to leverage new functionality.
  • Support multiple concurrent initiatives while effectively managing priorities, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or Associate degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing and developing custom business applications using Microsoft Power Apps, including Canvas and Model-Driven applications.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse, including data modeling, tables, relationships, security, and application integration.
  • Experience integrating Power Platform solutions with SharePoint, SQL Server, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Hands-on experience developing automated workflows and business processes using Power Automate.
  • Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and data models using Power BI.
  • Proficiency with Power Fx, JavaScript, and SQL to support advanced application functionality and integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, secure, responsive, and user-focused business applications.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical designs and working solutions.
  • Experience supporting solutions throughout the complete software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and enhancement.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex application and integration issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deliverables in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) certification.
  • Experience implementing Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) practices for Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
  • Experience working with Power Platform solutions, environments, deployment pipelines, source control, and release management.
  • Experience developing custom connectors and integrating Power Platform solutions with external APIs and enterprise systems.
  • Knowledge of Power Platform security, governance, performance optimization, and enterprise development best practices.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional product and development teams.
  • Previous experience supporting Federal Government customers or federal consulting engagements.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $108,000-122,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.

Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

  • Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, & vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
  • Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10) federal holidays
  • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
  • Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, & company-sponsored industry certifications!
  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

ACCESSIBILITY NOTE

NetImpact Strategies is committed to complying with all applicable provisions of the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended (“ADA”), and applicable state and local laws. It is NetImpact’s policy not to discriminate against any qualified person or applicant with regard to any terms or conditions of employment on the basis of such individual’s disability. Consistent with this policy of non-discrimination, NetImpact will provide reasonable accommodations to an individual with a disability, as defined in the ADA or applicable law, who has made NetImpact aware of his/her disability, unless doing so would cause undue hardship to NetImpact.
