raw.description:
Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a Knowledge Center Deputy Lead to supervise shifts of Tier I Knowledge Center agents supporting the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the KC through a dedicated toll-free number, support email, public web form, and public chatbot, and the KC agent creates and manages the ticket on their behalf. The Deputy Lead owns special projects and coordinates enterprise-wide updates and upgrades in preparation for external application changes. Additionally, this position will act as the Lead as needed (during absences). In this capacity, the Deputy will manage real-time shift performance against SLAs and XLAs, coaches agents on external-user handling and manual ticket creation, enforces the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and coordinates escalations to application resolver groups. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS REMOTE WORK ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Responsible to the KC Lead for the planning, training, stakeholder communications, and integration of all customer Tier 0/1 under the Knowledge Center.
  • Manages and plans for Enterprise-level KC support changes to customer applications.
  • Is the continuous liaison of the KC for Tier II/III providers to ensure constant communications and issue resolution.
  • Assists the KC Lead in the supervision of shifts of Tier I Knowledge Center agents supporting external users: scheduling and coverage across 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET, coaching, quality reviews of calls, emails, and manually created tickets, and performance management.
  • Own real-time shift performance for the KC (contact handling, First Contact Resolution, PL1-PL4 SLA adherence, CSAT/CES) and take corrective action to protect service levels for external users.
  • Enforce the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, accurate capture of external user information and issue details, and documented escalation procedures to application resolver groups.
  • Analyze shift-level trends by application and contribute to knowledge content, Tier 0 chatbot improvements, and Problem Management for external-user issues.
  • Supervise a team of Tier I service desk and Knowledge Center analysts across core hours (6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET) and extended-hours shifts, including scheduling, coverage planning, attendance, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
  • Own real-time and daily operational performance: monitor contact volumes, queue health, ticket aging, First Contact Resolution, Tier 0 deflection, and PL1-PL4 SLA adherence, and take corrective action to keep open tickets exceeding resolution SLA within the acceptable quality level.
  • Enforce the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and ticket documentation standards through a structured quality assurance program, including ticket audits, call and chat reviews, and calibrated feedback.
  • Lead the service desk's response to PL1/PL2 critical incidents, including communications, situational awareness alerts, and coordination with Tier II, endpoint, communications, and application resolver groups.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 2 years of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in enterprise IT service desk or end-user support, including at least 3 years supervising or leading a service desk team of 8 or more analysts.
  • Demonstrated experience managing to SLAs, XLAs, and KPIs such as First Contact Resolution, average speed to answer, ticket aging, CSAT, and Customer Effort Score.
  • Expert knowledge of an enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) including reporting, dashboards, and queue management.
  • Experience running quality assurance programs, coaching analysts, and managing performance and attendance.
  • Experience supervising multi-shift or extended-hours operations and coordinating on-call coverage.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience preparing operational performance reports and briefings for leadership and customers.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • HDI Support Center Manager, ITIL 4 Foundation or Practitioner, or equivalent service management certification.
  • Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community IT environments and working across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.
  • Experience deploying or operating AI-enabled Tier 0 capabilities (chatbots, Virtual Agent, automated password reset) and measuring ticket deflection.
  • Experience supporting external customer help desks and publicly accessible support channels (toll-free phone, email, web form).
  • Experience with Power BI or similar dashboard tools for performance reporting.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 20000-1 service management systems.

Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Staff Consultant - Project Coordinator to join the Medicaid Practice Group. As a Staff Consultant, you will accelerate your professional and personal growth through learning and collaborating with Medicaid Practice Group leaders. In this role you will learn to provide services to State Medicaid Agencies as they work to manage and mature their programs.

As a Staff Consultant - Project Coordinator you will initially be responsible for meeting preparation and follow-up, meeting notes, maintenance of the project's SharePoint site and related project logs, and support for project deliverables. Your initial duties will include taking and distributing meeting notes; tracking action items, issues, risks, and decisions; supporting the development of PowerPoint presentations; preparing and distributing meeting agendas; and supporting the development of project deliverables.

The successful candidate will be expected to learn quickly, be flexible, prioritize with ease, and be a great team player. Excellent relationship and communication skills are vital to the success of this role.

Travel Expectations: This role requires travel up to 25% of the time with additional flexibility to travel as client needs arise.

You Will

  • Provide project coordination support
  • Perform a wide variety of analytical tasks with continuous improvement of processes, personnel, organization, system or training
  • Prepare and distribute meeting agendas and notes
  • Collaborate with team to develop project deliverables
  • Track, monitor, and maintain project action items, decisions, risks, and issues within project logs
  • Maintain awareness of project status
  • Support engagement-wide communications
  • Proactively participate in team and client related meetings
  • Manage project SharePoint site
  • Perform assigned administrative tasks efficiently and effectively
  • Uphold firm quality standards
  • Establish and achieve development and performance goals
  • Collaborate with team members to maintain existing clients and attain new business
  • Participate in firm-wide initiatives

You Have

  • A BA/BS/MS Degree in Political Science, Public Health, Economics, Management Information Systems, Health Care Management, or Business
  • Experience in a professional work setting
  • Understanding of general Medicaid, HHS, and IT concepts
  • Excellent written, verbal, and non-verbal communication skills
  • Excellent analytic, problem-solving, and organizational skills

  • Proactive, positive, and eager attitude
  • Experience with MS PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively

The base salary range targeted for this role is $65,000 - $75,000. raw.title: Data Solutions Architect
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityRS&H is seeking an experienced Data Solutions Architect to design and deliver secure, scalable, and client-focused data and artificial intelligence solutions across our aviation, federal, transportation, aerospace, health and science, and corporate market sectors.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

RS&H is seeking an experienced Data Solutions Architect to design and deliver secure, scalable, and client-focused data and artificial intelligence solutions across our aviation, federal, transportation, aerospace, health and science, and corporate market sectors.

In this highly influential technical role, you will transform complex and inconsistent data into trusted pipelines, analytical models, predictive solutions, and visualizations that support critical client decisions. You will also identify recurring market needs and help turn early-stage concepts into configurable, production-ready digital offerings. The majority of this role focuses on advancing data and AI solutions from concept through requirements, architecture, development, testing, validation, and deployment. You will establish technical standards, strengthen data governance and model lifecycle practices, and lead a community of practice that builds data capabilities across the organization. This position has no direct reports but provides authoritative technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to project teams, architects, engineers, and junior staff.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and Deliver Data and AI Solutions
    • Lead the development of data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and visualization offerings, supporting solution scoping, client pursuits, production-grade delivery, governance, and data-practice enablement.
    • Translate challenges in buildings, infrastructure, and construction management into reusable data and AI products with clearly defined interfaces and service levels.
    • Design reusable solutions using application programming interfaces (APIs), event streams, curated datasets, feature stores, and visualization layers.
    • Prepare system diagrams, architecture decision records, data contracts, reference implementations, and build-versus-buy recommendations.
    • Architect geospatial intelligence solutions that integrate geographic information system (GIS) data, two-dimensional drawings, three-dimensional models, operational information, and sensor data.
    • Develop and deploy analytical and predictive models using time-series forecasting, causal inference, ensemble methods, and other machine learning techniques.
    • Create and operationalize interactive dashboards, analytical interfaces, and visualizations using Power BI and related tools.
    • Translate model outputs and statistical findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Advance associate-developed generative AI prototypes into secure, reliable, production-ready solutions.
    • Establish data quality requirements, validation processes, and remediation approaches as solutions move from development into production.
    • Incorporate data ownership, stewardship, lineage, quality, access controls, and model lifecycle management throughout solution development.
    • Design solutions that address architecture, engineering, construction, and public-sector requirements, including Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), NIST 800-171, Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), client data isolation, operational technology and information technology separation, and Microsoft Government Community Cloud High (GCC High) environments.
    • Develop reusable accelerators, including templates, schemas, connectors, evaluation frameworks, automated validation processes, authorization workflows, and infrastructure provisioning components.
    • Evaluate new ideas against defined advancement criteria and help teams shape concepts into viable data and AI offerings.
    • Collaborate with legal, finance, business subject matter experts, developers, and multidisciplinary product teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Scope End-to-End Solutions
    • Lead and participate in client and stakeholder discovery sessions.
    • Translate business needs and analytical questions into complete digital solution definitions.
    • Develop statements of work, concepts of operations, requirements, technical approaches, levels of effort, resource plans, and delivery schedules.
    • Facilitate meetings and workshops that advance concepts into products or services.
    • Define the analytical, geospatial intelligence, digital twin data, and visualization approaches used within each solution.
    • Develop technical content for proposals, presentations, and pursuit teams.
    • Support client-facing consulting engagements from initial concept and scoping through implementation and delivery.
  • Technical Leadership and Enablement
    • Lead the Data Community of Practice to support knowledge sharing, technical discussions, capability development, data product practices, data quality, and medallion architecture principles.
    • Establish analytical standards, validation methods, governance practices, and model lifecycle processes.
    • Communicate technical architectures, data structures, solution benefits, limitations, and recommendations in clear business terms.
    • Present digital solution concepts and technical strategies to executive leadership and client stakeholders.
    • Mentor architects and engineers in applied data science, model deployment, geospatial analysis, time-series forecasting, digital twin data workflows, and production-grade data practices.
    • Provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary project teams without direct supervisory responsibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Geography, or a related quantitative or technical discipline.
  • Fifteen (15) or more years of experience in applied data science, analytics engineering, data architecture, or a related discipline.
  • Full lifecycle experience developing data products, including concept development, requirements, architecture, model development, validation, deployment, and production support.
  • At least five (5) years of experience in client-facing consulting or professional services, including proposing, scoping, and delivering analytical solutions.
  • Current certification in a relevant technology domain or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Mastery of the Python data science ecosystem, including pandas, Polars, NumPy, and SciPy.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and R.
  • Expert knowledge of statistical modeling and machine learning frameworks, including scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
  • Demonstrated expertise in time-series forecasting, causal inference, feature engineering, and sampling or resampling techniques for imbalanced or sparse data.
  • Strong experience with geospatial analytics and LiDAR processing using tools such as ArcGIS, PostGIS, GeoPandas, GDAL/OGR, and PDAL.
  • Experience working with vector, raster, point-cloud, sensor, and operational data.
  • Deep experience with MLOps and model lifecycle management, including containerization, orchestration, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), experiment tracking, model monitoring, drift detection, and production deployment.
  • Experience deploying cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Advanced proficiency in interactive data visualization and dashboard development using Power BI, Tableau, Plotly/Dash, or geospatial visualization tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of responsible AI, data governance, bias detection and mitigation, model explainability, uncertainty quantification, and statistical reliability in regulated environments.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical methods, results, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
**Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States permanently. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or visa transfer.**

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Geography, or a related field.
  • Experience productizing prototypes, including software-as-a-service (SaaS) delivery and lean product incubation processes.
  • Domain experience in transportation, aviation, buildings, or construction operations.
  • Experience with traffic sensors, tolling systems, building automation systems, building information modeling (BIM), virtual design and construction (VDC), or facility telemetry.
  • Background in digital simulation environments, operational technology integration, or AI applications for infrastructure systems.
  • Familiarity with foundation model fine-tuning or multimodal modeling involving imagery, geospatial data, text, and sensor data.

Why Join Us

  • Apply your work to problems that matter. The solutions you build support critical infrastructure, facilities, transportation systems, and public programs that communities depend on every day.
  • Bring your own ideas forward. This is a venture environment within an established employee-owned firm where you can identify opportunities, build business cases, and help transform concepts into scalable market-ready solutions
  • Influence enterprise technology strategy. Help establish a trusted data foundation that enables innovation, operational excellence, and informed decision-making across the organization.
  • Lead through technical expertise. Set standards, guide solution architecture, mentor colleagues, and strengthen data and AI capabilities across the firm.
  • Share in what you help build. RS&H is employee-owned, and associates share in the success of the firm they create.

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Please view Equal Employment Opportunity Posters provided by OFCCP here.

Please note: no agency representation or submissions will be recognized for this vacancy. Candidates should apply directly to this role to be considered. It is the responsibility of all third-party recruiting and employment agencies to know and adhere to our recruiting policy.

The Company

Employee-owned, RS&H is one of the nation’s leading architecture, engineering, and consulting firms, with associates who work hard every day to create tomorrow together. We offer an exceptional journey from start to future. Our integrated teams translate experience into insight, turn challenges into opportunities, and build relationships that are as strong as the buildings and infrastructure we deliver together. We attribute our success to our unwavering commitment to our core values: integrity, accountability, curiosity, and teamwork.

The SaaS Key Account Representative will play a pivotal role in maintaining and growing relationships with key clients who utilize our Software as a Service (SaaS) and print solutions. You will be responsible for ensuring client satisfaction, driving product adoption, and maximizing revenue opportunities within your assigned key accounts. This role requires a combination of excellent communication skills, being extremely organized, technical knowledge of the SaaS product, and a strong focus on strategic customer success.   • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven experience in key account management, preferably in the SaaS industry.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex software solutions.
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

raw.description:
The Client Executive, Argano Microsoft Business Unit, is responsible for driving new business growth within the Healthcare and Life Sciences sector. This role leads complex, consultative sales engagements with economic buyers and senior decision-makers, aligning client priorities to the full Microsoft stack with particular emphasis on AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work. The ideal candidate brings executive presence, strong healthcare and life sciences industry knowledge, and a proven ability to lead strategic opportunities from initial engagement through close.

About Argano
Argano is a digital consultancy that helps organizations improve performance through strategy, transformation, and technology. Through its Microsoft Business Unit, Argano delivers expertise across AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work to help clients accelerate business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to grow Argano's Healthcare and Life Sciences business within the Microsoft Business Unit.
  • Build and advance a qualified pipeline through targeted business development and executive relationship management.
  • Lead complex sales pursuits focused on business transformation, digital innovation, and operational modernization outcomes.
  • Position the full Microsoft stack, with emphasis on AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work.
  • Engage healthcare and life sciences clients with insight into industry priorities such as patient and member experience, clinical and operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, data-driven decision-making, cybersecurity, and innovation.
  • Collaborate with internal leaders, solution teams, and Microsoft stakeholders to shape account strategy and proposals.
  • Lead executive-level client discussions, commercial negotiations, and deal progression through close.
  • Meet or exceed assigned revenue, pipeline, and growth objectives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field, preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of professional sales experience selling complex business and technology services.
  • Proven success selling to economic buyers and senior decision-makers within Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to exceed targets in enterprise, consultative sales environments.
  • Experience selling Microsoft solutions, especially AI, Business Applications, Security, and cloud platform offerings.
  • Strong CRM, pipeline management, and account planning discipline.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Ability to build pipeline, shape account strategy, and lead complex pursuits to close.
  • Healthcare and Life Sciences Industry Knowledge: Understanding of healthcare and life sciences business models, regulatory environments, and transformation priorities.
  • Executive Communication: Ability to engage credibly with senior executives, economic buyers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Microsoft Solution Selling: Ability to position the value of AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work.
  • Relationship Management: Ability to build trusted relationships across clients, partners, and internal teams.
  • Commercial Acumen: Sound judgment in deal strategy, negotiation, and business value alignment.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Sales Acumen: Ability to meet and exceed targets. Strong understanding of the sales process and ability to navigate complex sales cycles.
  • Industry Knowledge: Stay informed about industry trends and competitors.
  • Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Analytical Skills: Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze sales performance metrics.
  • Strategic Thinking: Develop and execute strategic account plans.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • Relationship Building: Establish and nurture relationships with potential clients. Collaborate with internal teams to provide effective solutions.
  • Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills to close deals that are mutually beneficial. Ability to handle objections and resolve conflicts.
  • Problem-Solving: Identify client challenges and propose effective solutions. Collaborate with internal teams to address client needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Argano is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made without regard to any legally protected characteristic.

raw.title: Manager, Talent Account Management
raw.excerpt: OverviewTogether, We Enhance Innovation and Growth The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close.
raw.description:
Overview

Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth

The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close. The TAMs own the hiring manager relationship and the candidate experience once a candidate enters an active process. This Manager makes sure that work is focused on the right roles, delivered to a consistent standard, and measured in a way the business can trust.

The role is accountable for delivery outcomes, reporting, customer satisfaction and escalations. It works from the priority order set jointly with the Capacity Planning Manager, so that TAM time goes to the roles that matter most to i2G's contracts and markets. It operates on Kastle Systems' talent platforms (iCIMS, LinkedIn and Indeed) and draws its candidate supply from Kastle's Sourcing team.

This is a leadership and delivery role, not a sourcing role and not a demand-planning role. It does not own the demand forecast, which sits with the Capacity Planning Manager. It does not own top-of-funnel sourcing, which sits with Kastle's Sourcing team. It owns what happens between those two: turning qualified leads into hires, and doing it well.

Reporting and working relationships

  • Chief Operating Officer, i2G (direct). Sets business priorities for the team, evaluates performance and is the escalation point for delivery and resourcing issues.
  • Senior Director, Talent Acquisition, Kastle Systems (indirect). Sets recruiting process standards, platform usage and compliance expectations, and partners on team practices and reporting.
  • Capacity Planning Manager, i2G (peer). Owns the labor demand forecast and the rolling requisition priority order. The two roles agree together where TAM effort goes each month.
  • Kastle Sourcing team (upstream partner). Supplies sourced and inbound candidates to the TAMs. This Manager owns the quality feedback loop back to Sourcing.
  • i2G hiring managers and branch leadership (customers). The people the TAMs serve. This Manager is the senior point of contact for their satisfaction and their escalations.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

1. Team leadership and coaching

  • Lead, coach and develop three Talent Account Managers. Set clear expectations, run regular one-to-ones and case reviews, and give direct performance feedback.
  • Assign requisition portfolios to TAMs based on priority, complexity, market and workload, and rebalance as demand shifts.
  • Set and audit the standard for the TAM role: intake quality, screening rigor, submittal quality, interview coordination, feedback turnaround, offer preparation and close.
  • Coach TAMs on running difficult conversations with hiring managers, including pushing back on unrealistic requirements or slow decisions.
  • Hire, onboard and backfill TAMs as needed, and maintain a development path for the team.

2. Prioritization and alignment with capacity planning

  • Work with the Capacity Planning Manager as the single point of alignment between operations demand and TAM delivery.
  • Run the team from the rolling 90-day requisition forecast and its agreed priority order. Confirm each month which roles get TAM focus first.
  • Make sure TAM effort follows priority, not volume of requests or the loudest hiring manager. Flag when priorities conflict or when demand exceeds what the team can deliver.
  • Take part in the monthly talent acquisition and operations review with data, recommendations and follow-through on decisions.
  • Raise early warning when a priority role is at risk, including the revenue or delivery consequence, so trade-offs are made with full information.

3. Hiring manager partnership and customer satisfaction

  • Own the operating relationship with i2G hiring managers and branch leadership at the leadership level, and hold the TAMs to a consistent service standard.
  • Set and enforce an intake standard so every requisition has a clear profile, priority, compensation range and interview plan before work begins.
  • Coach managers on selection, speed of decision, compensation and the realities of the candidate market. Hold managers accountable to agreed feedback and decision timelines.
  • Measure hiring manager satisfaction on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.
  • Own escalations: receive them, resolve them or route them, and close the loop with the manager and the COO.

4. Candidate experience and delivery quality

  • Set the standard for candidate communication, momentum and trust from first screen through offer and close, and audit against it.
  • Review pipeline health and requisition aging weekly. Intervene on stalled roles, slow feedback, weak submittals and offers at risk.
  • Protect TAM time for moving qualified talent to hire rather than searching from scratch. Send back leads that do not meet the bar, with specific feedback.
  • Measure candidate satisfaction and offer acceptance, and address the causes when either slips.
  • Advise on offer construction and close strategy for critical or hard-to-fill roles.

NOTE: This is a remote-global role. The hiring team is considering candidates wherever CRS is registered to work at. CRS does not sponsor visas for remote employees.

The Pay Range referenced in this job announcement only applies to applicants who perform the job within the US and to applicants classified by CRS as International Assignees. Staff hired on local payroll would follow the respective Country pay range. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your anticipated work location during the candidate selection process.

Pay Range

$95,173 - $117,498 Annually

Job Summary

The Deputy Chief of Party II will work as part of the leadership team for the anticipated Continuity of Integrated Health Services (CIHS) project, a multi-country initiative supporting Guinea, Liberia, Mali, and Togo. The Deputy Chief of Party II will provide strategic oversight and leadership for all project technical programming, ensuring the quality, integration, and effectiveness of interventions across malaria, maternal, newborn and child health (MNCH), health systems strengthening, infectious disease preparedness and response, and transition to country ownership.

The Deputy Chief of Party II will directly oversee the project's core team technical advisors and guide implementation of technical strategies aligned with the project's four objectives: (1) strengthening malaria and MNCH service delivery; (2) strengthening health information systems, laboratories, supply chains, and other health systems; (3) improving readiness to detect and respond to infectious disease threats; and (4) accelerating the transition to country-led health programs.

This position will ensure technical approaches are evidence-based, coordinated across countries, and aligned with host-country priorities and the America First Global Health Strategy. The Deputy Chief of Party II's management and technical knowledge will ensure the delivery of high-quality programming and achievement of project results. As a senior leader, the incumbent will proactively manage and mitigate technical risks and support a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Provide overall technical leadership for the development, implementation and consolidation of the CIHS project across malaria, MNCH, laboratory systems, disease surveillance, health information systems, supply chain strengthening, and other health systems strengthening interventions. Serve as the primary technical point of contact with the Department of State, as well as public, private and non-government stakeholders, when requested.
  • Lead the development and execution of an integrated technical strategy that advances the project's objectives and ensures coordination across technical disciplines, countries, and consortium partners. Ensure technical activities achieve high-quality, timely results and are aligned with donor priorities, country needs, and global best practices. Work closely with programmatic and operational leaders to promote effective implementation and ensure CRS program quality standards, MEAL policies, and procedures are consistently applied.
  • Effectively manage, supervise, mentor a multidisciplinary team of technical advisors. Foster collaboration across technical areas, manage team dynamics, and staff well-being. Strategically tailor individual development plans and complete performance assessments for direct reports.
  • Contribute to the development of staffing plans and the recruitment process of senior technical staff.
  • Manage and mitigate technical risks that may affect achievement of project objectives and milestones. Monitor evolving national health priorities, policy developments, and contextual factors that may affect implementation, and support risk mitigation strategies to maintain program quality and continuity. Ensure all staff understand and adhere to CRS staff safety, security, and safeguarding policies and plans.
  • Promote, uphold and model responsible stewardship of agency and donor resources. Help ensure technical activities are implemented efficiently and in compliance with donor requirements, while collaborating with CIHS leadership team to support sound budget management, reporting, and accountability.
  • Maintain relationships with key staff of consortium partner organizations in areas related to their respective scopes of work. Contribute to coordination of the roles and activities of staff from other consortium member organizations in implementation in line with CRS partnership principles.
  • Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement across the project. Create and maintain an environment that encourages collaborative problem-solving, the sharing of lessons learned, and adaptive management.
  • Identify technical capacity gaps among CRS, partner, and government stakeholders and propose targeted training, mentoring, and technical assistance to strengthen institutional and/or technical capacity and advance country ownership.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Staff management experience and abilities that are conducive to a learning environment.
  • Strong knowledge and experience in budget management.
  • Experience in MS Office package (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio), Web Conferencing Applications, and information and budget management systems.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, systems thinking, and problem-solving skills, with capacity to see the big picture and ability to make sound judgment and decisions.
  • Strong relations management abilities. Ability to relate to people at all levels internally and externally, especially with donors and government counterparts. Strategic in how you approach each relationship.
  • Team leadership abilities with diverse and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Proactive, resourceful, solutions-oriented and results-oriented.

Required Languages: English required, additional proficiency in French preferred

Travel: Must be willing and able to travel up to 30%.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

About TP

Benefits of working with TP include

We invest in and prioritize the mental health and well-being of our team members by providing resources, including Employment Assistance Programs, space in the form of health and personal time off (HPT), and leave programs as eligible.

We offer benefits and tools to help our team members and their families for their financial future. This includes offering competitive 401(K) plans, life insurance, supplemental medical coverage, critical care insurance, pet insurance, FSA plans, and retailer discounts.

Career Growth and Culture

At TP, we prioritize a culture of inclusion and diversity where every employee feels valued. We provide a platform for limitless career advancement, fostering an environment where ambition and high performance lead to long-term success.

TP is committed to supporting those who serve. We welcome applications from active-duty service members, veterans, and military families.

Equal Opportunity Employer

TP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you require reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at 877-877-3944 or contact us here. Please note, this contact channel is not a means to apply for or inquire about a position and we are unable to respond to non-accommodation-related requests.

Purpose

Keep TP's account-based marketing platforms built to standard, documented, and verified so campaigns launch clean and the data behind them holds up in reporting. This role owns the operational integrity of Demandbase, the DB1 Sales rollout, and LinkedIn campaign operations — the systems that let marketing prove what it produced.

This position is 100% work at home. While this position will be working from home, this candidate must be located within the US and Canada and be eligible to work in the US and Canada without sponsorship.

Responsibilities

Your Responsibilities

Demandbase Platform Operations

Build and QA audiences, segments, account lists, keyword intent sets, and journey stages to the documented standard, verifying each before launch.

Configure orchestration — trigger logic, suppression rules, exclusion states — so plays fire correctly against the right audiences.

Own campaign codes and intake: naming conventions, tracking parameters, and requests routed and logged.

Maintain platform documentation. Every build written down and kept current is a core deliverable of this role, not an afterthought.

Monitor configuration drift and correct it before it reaches a live campaign.

DB1 Sales Launch and Support

Stand up the sales-side pilot: user provisioning, guardrails, onboarding, and support for the pilot group.

Own credit-consumption guardrails and monitor usage so allotments last the pilot period.

Collect and document what works before any wider rollout to the sales organization.

Partner with SDR and BD leadership on adoption, training, and feedback loops.

LinkedIn Campaign Operations

Build and QA campaigns in Campaign Manager, including audience sync from Demandbase.

Maintain Insight Tag integrity across landing pages and thank-you pages.

Produce performance reporting from Campaign Manager and reconcile against invoiced spend.

Data Integrity and Reporting Support

Validate list pulls and audience loads against the account universe before activation.

Verify tag and tracking integrity across the landing-page estate in partnership with the web and marketing automation owners.

Supply platform-level engagement, intent, and coverage data into the reporting layer.

Not in Scope

ABM strategy, campaign creative, audience targeting decisions, and vertical program design sit with the ABM leads and integrated marketing. This role is execution and platform integrity.

Qualifications

Qualifications

1–3 years of hands-on ABM or marketing operations platform experience, or a strong recent graduate with demonstrable platform exposure.

Hands-on build experience in Demandbase preferred. 6sense, Terminus, or HubSpot operations experience transfers directly and is fully acceptable.

Certified in marketing and sales platforms — Demandbase certification preferred; Marketo, Salesforce, or comparable marketing automation certification a strong plus.

AI background — working knowledge of Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI, and a demonstrated habit of using them to move faster on operations work: list building, documentation, QA, and analysis.

Working knowledge of CRM data structures — Salesforce objects, campaign members, lead versus contact.

Fluency with UTM and campaign-code conventions and why they matter downstream.

A demonstrated documentation habit. Candidates should be able to produce a runbook or SOP they have written.

Detail orientation over speed. This role is judged on whether the build is correct, not how fast it shipped.

Fluency in English required.

Nice to Have

Basic reporting fluency — Salesforce reports and dashboard reading.

Intent-data familiarity and experience working with account tiering models.

Exposure to a B2B services or technology environment with a long sales cycle.

How We Screen

Candidates will be asked to name the specific objects they have built — audiences, segments, intent keyword sets, journey stages, suppression rules, orchestration triggers. Finalists will complete a short practical exercise: a small platform build, documented clearly enough that another person could repeat it.

What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months

First 30 Days

Demandbase environment audited — existing audiences, segments, intent keyword sets, and journey stages inventoried and current state documented.

Campaign-code and intake conventions written down, with a single logged request queue operating.

Insight Tag coverage verified across the active landing-page estate, with gaps listed and owners assigned.

By 90 Days

The documented build standard is in use for every new Demandbase object, with QA verified before launch rather than after.

DB1 Sales pilot is live for the initial user group — provisioning, guardrails, and onboarding complete.

Credit-consumption monitoring is running against a defined allotment threshold, with usage reported to the Director monthly.

LinkedIn campaigns are building and QAing on cadence, with Campaign Manager reporting reconciled to invoiced spend each month.

By Six Months

Demandbase builds are consistently documented, with a maintained library of runbooks another team member could execute from.

DB1 Sales adoption is tracked against the pilot group, with documented findings ready to support a wider rollout decision.

LinkedIn campaigns launch with verified tag integrity, and performance reporting reconciles to spend.

Campaign codes and intake follow a single convention, with no unlogged requests.

Platform issues are surfaced and corrected before they reach a live campaign rather than after.

Reporting Line

Reports to the Sr. Manager, Performance Marketing, North America Marketing.

Soft Skills

  • Process Excellence
  • Collaboration
  • Communication
  • Emotional Intelligence
  • Open-Mindedness
  • Critical Thinking
  • Solution Orientation
  • Entrepreneurship
  • AI Proficiency
  • Data Literacy 

Be Part of Our TP Family

It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. We are committed to providing a workplace that is conducive to happiness and a healthy work-life balance. We also believe that to be our best selves, we need to be surrounded by people who are positive, supportive, and challenging. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and diversity, where everyone feels welcome and valued.

The Software Developer’s primary role is designing, developing, testing, and deploying end-to-end software applications and automations. The base pay estimate for this role is $66,900-$113,700 annually. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

  • Collaborates respectfully with other team members.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in an appropriate field of study and 3+ years of experience as a software developer.
  • 3+ years of experience performing root cause analysis and other troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Full understanding of Well Architected Frameworks.
  • 3+ years of experience with functional, imperative, and object-oriented languages (knowledge of C# and Java is preferred).

Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

C&F’s Commercial Lines division delivers specialized insurance solutions for mid-sized and large businesses across a broad range of commercial exposures, management liabilities, and industry segments.

Our portfolio includes tailored coverage solutions for General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Property, and Excess Liability, as well as Financial Lines products such as Management Liability, Professional Liability, Cyber, Crime, and Fidelity.

With more than 700 employees across the United States, Commercial Lines combines deep underwriting expertise, disciplined risk selection, and the strength of C&F’s national platform. We work closely with our customers and distribution partners to provide responsive service, thoughtful risk solutions, and the confidence to navigate complex business challenges.

The Director of Claims Enablement leads the optimization and automation of claims processes, balancing technology-driven efficiency with operational excellence. This role ensures scalable growth and cost control by leveraging advanced tools and continuous improvement methodologies, while fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and high-quality service across the claims team.

What You Will Do for C&F:

  • Strategic Leadership & Optimization
    • Develop and execute a comprehensive claims enablement strategy focused on operational excellence, automation, and scalability.
    • Identify, evaluate, and implement process improvements and technology solutions to optimize workflows and reduce manual effort.
    • Champion the use of data analytics, AI, and automation tools to streamline claims intake, triage, assignment, and resolution.
    • Collaborate with IT, business partners, and vendors to ensure seamless integration of new technologies and systems.
  • Automation & Technology Advancement
    • Lead initiatives to automate routine claims processes, leveraging available platforms and emerging technologies.
    • Oversee the deployment and adoption of digital tools, including claims management systems, reporting applications, and communication platforms.
    • Monitor technology performance, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvement in system utilization.
  • Performance Management & Team Development
    • Build and lead high-performing teams, providing coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
    • Establish clear performance metrics and accountability standards aligned with business objectives.
    • Drive a culture of innovation, agility, and customer-centricity within the claims enablement function.
  • Resource Planning & Cost Management
    • Anticipate resource needs and recommend optimal staffing and budget levels to support business growth without increasing costs.
    • Develop scalable processes and automation strategies to handle increased claim volumes efficiently.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
    • Serve as a key liaison between claims, IT, underwriting, and other business units to ensure alignment on enablement initiatives.
    • Represent Claims Enablement on corporate projects, ensuring adherence to quality, compliance, and operational standards.
    • Communicate effectively with senior leadership, providing regular updates on optimization and automation progress.

What You Will Bring to C&F:

  • A Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and 10+ years of experience.
  • Proven experience in claims operations, enablement, or process optimization within the insurance industry.
  • Demonstrated success in leading automation and technology-driven transformation initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in leveraging data to drive decision-making.
  • Expertise in claims management systems, workflow automation tools, and reporting applications.
  • Ability to innovate and implement best practices, with a focus on scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Commitment to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture.

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

If you require special accommodations, please let us know. We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require special accommodations, please let us know

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $82,500.00 to a maximum of $155,100.00. The actual compensation is determined by various factors, including but not limited to the market pay for the jobs at each level, the responsibilities and skills required for each job, and the employee’s contribution (performance) in that role. To be considered within market range, a salary is at or above the minimum of the range. You may also have the opportunity to participate in discretionary equity (stock) based compensation and/or performance-based variable pay programs.

Overview

RealPage is seeking a strategic, innovative, and results‑driven Sr. Product Manager to help lead the evolution of our Renter’s Insurance portfolio within the Resident Solutions business unit. This role collaborates with fellow product managers and SME’s to define and drive the roadmap, strategy, and business performance of our insurance products, including platform capabilities, digital experiences, suite integrations, and acquisition funnels.

You will be responsible for driving meaningful growth, strengthening our value proposition, leveraging emerging technologies (including AI), and ensuring we continue to win in an increasingly competitive space at the intersection of proptech and insurtech.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong business acumen with customer empathy, data‑driven decision making, a passion for experimentation, and a deep desire to deliver category‑leading products.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Develop and communicate the strategic product vision for offerings within the insurance portfolio aligned with the Resident Solutions strategic goals.
  • Identify new market opportunities, competitive threats, and partnership pathways to grow adoption and revenue.
  • Translate industry trends in insurance, e‑commerce, proptech, insurtech, and AI into actionable product initiatives.

Roadmap Ownership & Execution

  • Own your product’s roadmap from ideation through launch and iteration.
  • Prioritize features and enhancements using a structured approach informed by customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Draft comprehensive Product Requirements Documentation consistent with RealPage standards that support optimal development velocity and minimize re-work.
  • Partner closely with engineering, marketing, design, operations and other RealPage product teams to bring solutions to market.

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Lead an experimentation culture using A/B testing, rapid hypothesis validation, and test‑learn‑iterate cycles.
  • Continuously optimize funnels, user experiences, and digital flows to drive conversion and retention.

Customer & Market Insights

  • Conduct client and resident interviews, analyze behavioral data, and mine operational and financial metrics to deeply understand user needs.
  • Represent the voice of both residents and property management stakeholders across the organization.

Business Performance & Accountability

  • Own KPIs including enrollment, revenue, churn, premium/policy, and customer experience outcomes.
  • Develop, tune and monitor performance dashboards and drive initiatives to accelerate growth.
  • Collaborate with finance, analytics, and channel partners to improve product economics and embedded distribution.
  • Analyze, triage and troubleshoot product issues impacting internal and external stakeholders including implementation, customer support, clients, residents and our insurance carriers.

Cross‑Functional Leadership

  • Work collaboratively across Resident Solutions, insurance carriers, legal, marketing, and sales to ensure cohesive and compliant product delivery.
  • Provide clear communication, documentation, and alignment across RealPage business units.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of product management experience (preferably in fintech, insurtech, SaaS, or e‑commerce).
  • Proven record of delivering successful products that drive measurable business impact.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Experience in experimentation frameworks, funnel optimization, and A/B testing.
  • Ability to collaborate cross‑functionally and influence without authority.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting to senior leadership.
  • Experience with SAFe Agile and Scrum

Preferred

  • Knowledge of insurance, renter’s insurance, or related regulatory environments.
  • Experience in proptech or real estate technology.
  • Exposure to AI/ML‑powered product features, personalization engines, or predictive analytics.
  • Understanding of underwriting concepts, risk management, or insurance operations.

Attributes of a Successful Candidate

  • Strategic thinker who understands the bigger picture and anticipates future trends.
  • Bias for action with a strong desire to win and grow the business.
  • Data‑driven decision maker who thrives in a hypothesis‑driven environment.
  • Customer champion who deeply values user experience.
  • Creative problem solver who finds elegant solutions to complex challenges.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with resilience and adaptability.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

USD $94,700.00 - USD $161,300.00 /Yr.

Director of Sales (EU)

About Doodle Labs

Doodle Labs builds the connectivity backbone of the autonomous systems revolution — resilient wireless mesh networks that let drones, robots, and unmanned platforms operate reliably in the world's most demanding environments. We sit at the intersection of defense, robotics, and next-generation autonomy, powering the machines that are changing how militaries, first responders, and industries operate in the field. Our core purpose is simple: connect anyone and anything, at any time, in any place.

For over 25 years, our team has been at the forefront of mesh networking, partnering with leading defense programs, robotics manufacturers, and system integrators worldwide. The work here doesn't sit in a slide deck — it ends up in the field, in the hands of people for whom failure isn't an option.

About the Role

The Director of Sales (EU) is a senior, EU-based remote individual contributor responsible for driving revenue growth across key drone and robotics OEM accounts throughout Europe, extending and promoting the Doodle Labs brand as we build out our presence in the region.

In this role, you will pursue new strategic opportunities, develop high-value customer relationships, and guide accounts through the full sales lifecycle—from initial engagement and system integration through production scale. You will work closely with sales engineering and product teams to ensure successful technical adoption of Doodle Labs’ wireless networking technologies.

This position requires a highly driven sales professional who excels at navigating complex technical sales cycles, building executive relationships, and closing multi-stakeholder deals across the unmanned systems ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and win priority drone OEM accounts across the European market
    • Own strategic accounts across the full customer lifecycle from initial engagement through production scale
    • Lead account strategy, executive relationship development, and commercial negotiations
    • Drive complex opportunities from early engagement through integration, qualification, and production deployment
    • Partner closely with Sales Engineering to support technical evaluations and system design-ins
    • Build and maintain a high-quality, forecastable sales pipeline
    • Act as the commercial lead for complex, multi-stakeholder deals across engineering, procurement, and executive leadership

What Success Looks Like

  • Successful acquisition of new drone OEM customers and platform integrations
    • Meaningful revenue growth from priority strategic accounts
    • Expansion of Doodle Labs technology across multiple programs and platforms within key customers
    • Strong relationships with both engineering teams and executive stakeholders
    • Predictable, well-managed pipeline supporting sustained regional growth
    • Qualified pipeline built quickly, with initial customer meetings secured within the first 30 days

Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of B2B hardware sales experience within the drone or unmanned systems industry
    • Proven sales hunter with a track record of closing complex OEM deals
    • Experience selling directly to drone manufacturers or robotics OEMs
    • Ability to lead complex technical sales cycles from first engagement through commercial close
    • Comfortable managing strategic accounts and multi-stakeholder buying processes
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
    • Technical or engineering-related educational background
    • Existing right to work within the EU or UK

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with RF or wireless communications technology
    • Experience in tactical communications or the broader unmanned systems industry

• Military background

Why Join Doodle Labs

  • Work on cutting-edge technology powering the future of autonomous systems
    • Collaborate with engineers and innovators building industry-leading connectivity solutions
    • Make a meaningful impact in a fast-growing company shaping the next generation of robotics and wireless networking

Travel Expectations This role requires approximately 50% travel for customer meetings, demonstrations, and industry events across Europe.

Compensation: Final base pay is determined based on the successful candidate's country of employment and experience level, in addition to other job-related qualifications.

Salary: €90,000 – €122,000 / year

  • Operate in multi-channel (phone and email) servicing environments where you are accountable to key performance indicators of success, such as Customer satisfaction (CSAT), key productivity metrics (for example call adherence and call service metrics

We’re looking for fearless people – people who are inspired to What we Prefer deliver only the best in all that we do.

  • Process Excellence: Demonstrate commitment to following established procedures and be customer service driven.

  • Open-Mindedness: Open-minded approach to feedback, evolving policies, and working within a structured schedule that includes a variety of shifts.

Prior experience of working with active-duty military, veterans, or government travelers is a significant advantage.

Job Title - Senior Manager, Phishing-Takedown

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Senior Manager to lead the phishing takedown function within a cybersecurity or trust & safety organisation. This role will be responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of phishing incident detection, partner-relationship management (registrars, hosting providers, platforms), rapid takedowns, process refinement and team leadership. The successful candidate will ensure that threats to the organisations brand, customers and digital ecosystem are mitigated swiftly, effectively and globally.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the global strategy for phishing takedown operations: define SLAs (e.g., domain/URL takedown within hours), workflows, escalation paths and performance metrics.

Lead and manage the team responsible for phishing takedown and abuse remediation: set objectives, mentor staff, manage budgets and drive continuous improvement.

Establish and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders: domain registrars, TLD/ccTLD registries, hosting/CDN providers, law-enforcement liaisons, platform abuse desks and technology partners.

Negotiate outlines of understanding (MOUs), priority takedown agreements, data-sharing or API access with external partners to ensure rapid response capabilities.

Oversee the end-to-end takedown process: from detection/triage of phishing sites, verification, partner engagement, takedown execution, confirmation and reporting.

Collaborate with threat intelligence, SOC, product, legal/compliance and security operations teams to align takedown efforts with broader incident response and brand-protection programmes.

Monitor phishing and digital-abuse trends (domains, impersonation sites, malicious apps, social-media abuse) and use insights to refine strategy, tooling and workflows.

Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of KPIs: takedown time, success rates, volumes, partner performance, cost per case, escalations and residual risk.

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at .

As an outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Bitwarden, you will play a pivotal role as a Product Specialist, acting as the first point of contact for potential customers. Your responsibilities will include developing a deep understanding of our sales process, researching leads, initiating new relationships, and setting the stage for our sales team's success. You will engage primarily in outbound sales activities, showcasing our offerings compellingly through various channels.

This position is open to candidates currently residing anywhere within the UK.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Generate sales leads by effectively prospecting and engaging potential Mid-Market and Enterprise clients through outbound outreach.
  • Manage and maintain an outbound sales pipeline, ensuring optimal lead and prospect qualification.
  • Identify and respond to potential client’s needs and suggest appropriate solutions.
  • Follow the sales playbook to guide sales leads through an Account Executive-led buying process.
  • Adhere to service-level agreements on lead outreach and follow-up intervals.

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 2+ years of outbound sales experience as a Sales Development Representative in the technology / SaaS space.
  • Experience using a CRM tool such as HubSpot, Outreach, or a similar engagement tool.
  • Experience using prospecting tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar, particularly in Enterprise B2B environments.
  • Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to quickly articulate technical information concisely.
  • Effective problem-solving abilities, coupled with strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Innovative thinker who thrives in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Collaborative team player willing to share best practices and learn from others.
  • Demonstrates persistence, resilience, and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • A 4-year degree or equivalent is preferred.

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team
  • Interview with SDR Manager
  • SDR Skills Assessment
  • Interview with Head of Enablement
  • References

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us, and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open-source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world and take part in productive and fun meetups.
  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

raw.description:
Job Purpose

As the Senior Director of Global Pricing, you will be a pivotal leader in RWS's strategic transformation into a tech‑based commercial organization. Reporting directly to executive leadership, you will spearhead our evolution from traditional service-based models to a unified, recurring revenue framework built on SaaS and consumption-based pricing.

This role is highly collaborative, requiring deep engagement with senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design and embed a holistic pricing ecosystem spanning our Generate, Transform, and Protect pillars. You will be the primary driver in executing a strategy that intelligently bundles our proprietary technology and world-class services—accelerating high‑margin, scalable growth and empowering our global sales force through advanced CPQ automation.

Success in this role hinges on your ability to build trusted partnerships, influence diverse senior audiences, and create alignment across global teams as we navigate significant commercial transformation.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing & Offer Design

  • Lead the business model transformation from transactional pricing to subscription and consumption-based models that capture the full value of our offerings
  • Develop sophisticated pricing for integrated Tech + Service offers, architecting solutions at the intersection of our proprietary AI-driven technology and premier human-in-the-loop services
  • Drive the strategic overhaul of the Trados product portfolio, transitioning from a legacy license‑and‑maintenance structure to a modern, multi-tiered SaaS model that maximizes ACV and accelerates subscription adoption
  • Define and iterate pricing for new, high-growth ventures—such as AI Dubbing—ensuring commercially compelling models that support rapid global expansion
  • Collaborate closely with Product, GTM, and Finance leaders to ensure pricing strategies are co‑created, aligned, and scalable across regions and customer segments
  • Engage stakeholders early in design cycles to build buy‑in and ensure pricing models are understood, adopted, and reinforced throughout the organisation

CPQ Digital Transformation

  • Architect and drive the enterprise-wide CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) digital transformation, creating a unified system across all commercial pillars
  • Empower the global sales organization to autonomously generate complex, high‑value quotes combining software subscriptions, API usage, and tiered service credits
  • Design and implement intelligent, automated approval workflows to eliminate "Deal Desk" friction and dramatically improve commercial velocity
  • Partner with Sales Operations, IT, and Regional Leadership to ensure CPQ capabilities reflect real-world needs and deliver a seamless user experience
  • Facilitate cross-functional working groups to maintain alignment, resolve competing priorities, and secure commitment to system adoption

Commercial Enablement & Deal Engineering

  • Act as the senior strategic partner for enterprise-level global bids, engineering deal structures that embed our unique technology value and secure long-term, profitable relationships
  • Develop self-service commercial modelling tools within the CRM, enabling sales teams to model and present compelling pricing scenarios in real-time
  • Maintain a constant pulse on the competitive landscape to ensure RWS’s pricing and value proposition remain market-leading
  • Engage executive stakeholders to navigate strategic trade-offs, gain approvals, and align pricing decisions with broader corporate objectives

Skills & Experience

  • B2B Tech/SaaS Experience: Demonstratable experience in a senior Pricing, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Strategy role within B2B SaaS or Tech‑Enabled Services
  • Transformational Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead a traditional sales organization through cultural and operational shifts
  • CPQ Architecture: Proven experience architecting and leading a large-scale CPQ implementation (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, DealHub) in a complex, hybrid software-and-services business.
  • Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Deep expertise in pricing new technology, restructuring legacy portfolios, and modeling complex revenue scenarios
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Skilled at building cross-functional partnerships, aligning diverse teams behind a unified commercial vision, facilitating decision-making in complex environments and influencing at C‑suite and senior leadership levels

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

Recruitment Agencies: RWS Holdings PLC does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward any unsolicited resumes to any RWS employees. Any unsolicited resume received will be treated as the property of RWS and Terms & Conditions associated with the use of such resume will be considered null and void.
