Overview

At ALTOUR, we believe people are the driving force behind every meaningful connection - our clients’ and our own. With more than 1,000 team members and a presence in over 80 countries, we are a globally recognized leader in corporate travel management and a proud division of Internova Travel Group, the highest-ranking American corporate travel management company (Business Travel News).

Our mission is to manage the complexities of connecting people so they can represent their brands in the most impactful way possible. That same philosophy shapes our workplace culture, one that evolves, improves, and empowers our people to grow and thrive.

We embrace innovation and leading-edge technology to create smarter, faster, and more tailored solutions - not just for our clients, but for each other. At ALTOUR, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your voice matters and your success is a shared journey. Click here for more information about Altour.

Responsibilities

Direct leadership of travel agent team. Provides coaching and development to optimum performance using all tools available. Supports the development and implementation strategic plans to drive the highest levels of customer service combined with operational consistency & efficiencies. Support client satisfaction, retention and business profitability objectives as measured by key performance indicators and department goals.

Responsibilities

People Leadership

  • Provides day to day guidance to agent team within span of control
    • Ability to identify team strengths/development opportunities, identify top talent
    • Develops solid plans in place to plans in place to drive results
    • Monitors success measurements frequently.
  • Provides frequent and timely feedback through one on one interaction, team meetings, and other forms of communication for all direct reports
  • Provides both positive and constructive feedback as required
  • Completes HR interactions/functions as needed – including payroll functions.
  • Clearly communicates the departmental vision and mission to all team members
  • Works closely with Work Force Analyst to develop schedules, monitor attendance, align time for non-phone related work and coaching sessions

Quality, Expense Management and Productivity

  • Works to mitigate expense due to quality errors
    • Reviews customer service reports monthly, completes appropriate analysis of issues, and works to quickly identify trends or issues within area of responsibility.
  • Supports service level management through attendance at daily huddles and planning session. Reviews any exception time off requests with Work Force Manager.
  • Closely monitors use of overtime, works with Work Force Management Team to align on optimal schedules and staffing requirements to reduce the need for overtime expense
  • Monitors all write offs and payouts, works closely with Director to create strategies to mitigate payout risks.
  • Reviews agent productivity measures, offers suggestions and develops plans for process improvement as needed

Client Satisfaction

  • Works closely with Director of Service Delivery and Account Management to support new and existing client programs.
  • Acts as primary contact for day to day operational questions for internal and external clients
  • Works closely with all ALTOUR internal departments to ensure client program success

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • 5-7 years’ experience in the travel industry
    • Ability to relate to and understand agent and supervisor roles
  • 5-7 years’ customer service experience
    • Ability to respond to high level escalated customer service issues.
    • Ability to identify root cause, creating process improvement to have wider impact.
    • Ability to interface with the Travel Manger and Account Managers and create meaningful internal and external partnerships.
  • Proficient in designated Sabre GDS
  • Strong knowledge of international travel
  • Excellent written and verbal skills
    • Ability to present material to groups of various sizes
    • Ability to craft compelling written and oral communication pieces for internal/external clients and staff
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Strong Microsoft office skills (word, excel)
    • Ability to complete simple analysis
    • Build/utilize simple spreadsheets/word documents

Leadership Abilities:

  • Has strong understanding of own skill set and development opportunities
  • Self-starter, takes ownership for own work, consistently meets deadlines
    • Comes prepared to meetings and participates appropriately
    • Strong understanding of the organizational road map
    • Develops strong relationships and partnerships with key departmental contacts
  • Demonstrates strong change management skills, ability to understand and contribute to the formulation of strategic decisions and support them
  • Demonstrates exceptional teamwork
    • Proactively offers support when ability matches need/reaches out across teams and departments
    • Shares best practices and ideas with peers and leaders
    • Utilizes Reward-A-Leaders system to recognize others
  • Consistently demonstrates mastery of the guiding principles in daily work habits
  • Ability to provide constructive feedback to agents, peers, and leaders when appropriate
  • Demonstrates high level decision making skills
    • Solutions oriented
    • Proactively anticipates potential issues and problems, takes steps to mitigate
    • Thinks creatively to find best/appropriate solution to difficult problems
    • Able to support peers in decision making
    • Knows when to escalate to a leader
    • Demonstrates strong conflict resolution skills

PAY AND BENEFITS

Our benefit offerings include choice of two medical plans and two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), company-paid life insurance and AD&D, optional additional life insurance and AD&D, disability insurance, paid parental leave, paid time off, 401k Plan with company match, discounted employee travel options, access to LinkedIn Learning webinars and courses. Discounted pet insurance and auto, home, & renters insurance.

Summary

Fire Creek Services Company, an All Native Group company, is seeking a Data / BI Analyst to build performance dashboards and monthly performance reports for facility maintenance operations (resolution time, first-time fix, emergency response, preventive maintenance compliance, parts fill rate, data completeness and customer satisfaction), along with failure and lifecycle analyses that guide improvement. This is an immediate opening.

Essential Functions

  • Define performance baselines, calculation rules and exclusions with the Government customer, and report by request priority, asset class and zone.
  • Build and maintain operational dashboards that show source timestamps and data sync status.
  • Produce monthly performance and cost-avoidance reports.
  • Analyze failure codes and repeat visits, and support parts-demand planning using historical work-request data.
  • Validate data for accuracy, completeness and timeliness before publishing reports.
  • Document metric definitions, calculation rules and data sources in a data dictionary.
  • Protect sensitive data and follow data privacy and controlled unclassified information (CUI) handling practices.

Competencies

  • SQL and data analysis
  • Dashboard design and data visualization
  • Maintenance performance metrics
  • Explaining data quality issues to operations staff
  • Data validation and documentation

Supervisory Responsibility

None required for this position

Work Environment

Remote or office-based, computer-focused work, with periodic on-site travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lb.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

Full-time and part-time positions available. Typical hours are Monday through Friday, daytime.

Travel

Daily local travel between buildings on the installation.

Experience

  • 4+ years of BI or reporting experience using SQL.
  • Strong SQL and dashboard design skills.
  • Ability to explain data quality issues to operations staff.

Preferred:

  • Maintenance or operations KPI reporting.
  • Maximo/BIRT or Cognos reporting.
  • Failure analysis (MTBF/MTTR).
  • Facility lifecycle decision support.
  • Experience with Power BI data modeling (DAX).
  • Familiarity with data governance and privacy practices.
  • Experience working on Department of Defense (DoD) installations, contracts or programs is a plus.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Power BI or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Must be able to pass a background check and obtain installation access.

Drug Free Workplace

All Native Group is a Drug Free Workplace. It is our policy that all new hires must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screen as a condition of employment. In addition, all employees are subject to random drug screens throughout the term of their employment with All Native Group.

Security Clearance

None

AAP/EEO Statement 

All Native Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. However, preference may be extended to persons of Indian descent in accordance with applicable laws.

About Ho-Chunk, Inc. & All Native Group

Ho-Chunk, Inc. is an award-winning economic development corporation of the Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska. Our mission is to provide long-term economic development for the Winnebago Tribe and job opportunities for Tribal members.

All Native Group is a network of small businesses that support the critical missions of various U.S. Government customers. Our capabilities include telecommunications, health, logistics, specialized training, professional services, and IT solutions. Since earning our first federal contract in 2004, we have continued to grow and diversify our services while maintaining a strong commitment to excellence. As a tribally owned organization, All Native Group operates multiple subsidiary businesses, providing clients with the advantages of working with a small business while leveraging the resources and expertise of a larger, established company. Our work is guided by our core NATIVE values:

  • Native American Owned & Proud – Serving the Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska.
  • Accountable – To always do what’s right.
  • Team-Focused – For inclusive progress.
  • Innovative – In creating solutions.
  • Visionary – In our purpose and direction.
  • Excellence – Through learning and performance.

Other Duties

Responsibilities

SafeGuard Services (SGS), a subsidiary of Peraton, performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse.

We are looking to add an Admin Action Specialist to our SGS team of talented professionals.

What you'll do:

The Admin Action Specialist is responsible for being a Point of Contact for CMS regarding all administrative actions related to investigations. Developing and submitting an action to CMS for approval. Maintaining a high-volume workload that requires quick actions and multiple metrics.

  • Review and verify evidence supporting administrative action as it relates to payment suspensions, revocations, overpayments as well as other administrative actions that can be pursued (payment suspension, revocation, prepayment edits, auto-denial edits).
  • Work with the Investigative Teams to ensure that the documentation gathered is sufficient to support an administrative action.
  • Work with CMS, law enforcement and the Medicare Administrative Contractor throughout the life of the action.
  • Monitor workload to ensure all actions are taken within the required timeframes set forth in the Program Integrity Manual.
  • Prepare and submit administrative action packages to CMS and the MACs for approval and processing and speak to the action development.
  • Telework available from eastern time zone

Qualifications

  • 5 years with BS/BA or 9 years with a HS Diploma/equivalent
  • Knowledge of Medicare requirements, laws, rules and regulations related to payment for services billed to the Program
  • Strong communication and organization skills
  • Experience in reviewing claims, performing medical reviews, and/or developing fraud cases
  • Strong PC knowledge and skills

Job Summary

Senior Interoperability Architect, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP)

Job Summary:

Aptive seeks a Senior Interoperability Architect to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will develop, refine, and maintain the interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, and profiles, that define how Veteran health information moves between VistA/CPRS, the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), the Department of Defense, and community providers. The role supports the Interoperability specialty area, including the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), FHIR standards innovation, standards-based interfaces, and national exchange frameworks. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside interoperability specialists, terminologists, and VA Business Owners.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Interoperability Specifications. Develop, refine, and maintain interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, profiles, and implementation guides, for VA exchange use cases.
  • Standards Analysis. Analyze industry standards, VHA business requirements, and relevant technological innovation to recommend specification approaches.
  • HL7 and FHIR Design. Design solutions using HL7 V2, C-CDA, and FHIR, including FHIR profiles and API specifications that extend VA’s use of standards-based APIs.
  • Community Care and Partner Exchange. Define specifications that support exchange with community care providers, the Department of Defense, and other partners, aligned to national exchange frameworks.
  • Device and System Interfaces. Develop standards-based specifications for device and system interfaces that support the Federal EHR.
  • Discovery Projects. Lead discovery and prototyping for new standards needs, such as consent management and time zone interoperability.
  • Conformance and Adoption. Define conformance criteria and testing approaches, and track adoption of standards across VA systems and exchange partners.
  • Federal Policy Alignment. Align specifications with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework, USCDI, and applicable federal interoperability policy.
  • Architecture Runway Collaboration. Contribute interoperability architecture inputs to OCI’s Architecture Runway Collaborative and to cross-team dependency reviews.
  • Agile Team Participation. Participate in Planning Interval (PI) Planning, backlog refinement, iteration ceremonies, and system demos; help decompose Epics into Features with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Technical Guidance and Briefings. Provide technical guidance to analysts and informaticists, and present architecture recommendations to OCI leadership and VA Business Owners.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in standards development, adoption, and conformance.
  • Experience developing, refining, or maintaining interoperability specifications, such as standards, data models, profiles, or implementation guides.
  • Familiarity with HL7 specifications, including V2, C-CDA, and FHIR.
  • Familiarity with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework and related federal interoperability policies.
  • Experience analyzing industry standards and business requirements to design interoperability solutions.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization.

Desired Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in health informatics, computer science, or a related field.
  • HL7 FHIR Proficiency or another HL7 certification.
  • Experience authoring FHIR implementation guides, participating in HL7 workgroups, or sponsoring ballots.
  • Experience with national exchange frameworks, such as eHealth Exchange, Carequality, CommonWell, or TEFCA.
  • Experience with FHIR conformance testing tools, such as Inferno, Touchstone, or the HL7 FHIR Validator.
  • Experience with VA systems, such as VistA/CPRS, VHIE, JLV, or VA Lighthouse APIs, or with the Federal EHR (Oracle Health).
  • Experience on SAFe or Scrum teams.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

EEO Statement

raw.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is seeking a Cribl/Splunk Engineer to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team!
raw.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Cribl/Splunk Engineer to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team!

The Cribl/Splunk Engineer will design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable data ingestion pipelines using Cribl Edge, Cribl Cloud, and Splunk across a variety of cybersecurity data sources. This role is responsible for optimizing data flows, storage, and infrastructure to improve performance, maintain data integrity, meet OMB M-26-14 requirements, and maximize cost efficiency. The Engineer will administer and maintain Cribl and Splunk environments, troubleshoot technical issues, perform upgrades, and collaborate with SOC and cross-functional teams on tool integration, tuning, and incident response. The ideal candidate brings strong Splunk engineering experience, hands-on Cribl expertise, and the ability to optimize high-volume security data environments for performance, security, and cost.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience

  • 4 years of Information Technology Experience
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, related degree or an additional two (2) years of experience.
  • 3+ years of Splunk administration or engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in configuring and managing Splunk inputs, setting up data ingestion pipelines, and establishing system connections.
  • Knowledge of Splunk's Search Processing Language (SPL), data parsing techniques, and the use of regular expressions for data extraction and transformation.
  • Skilled in optimizing data pipelines for performance and efficiency, handling large data volumes, and implementing best practices for data integrity and consistency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cribl Certified Service Consultant (CCSC) or Cribl Certified Engineer (CC Engineer) preferred.
  • Cribl Certified Admin (Stream and/or Edge) acceptable.
  • Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud Certified Admin bonus.
  • Experience as an engineering team lead (representing the team's work to clients).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement processes for ingesting data from various sources into Splunk using Cribl Edge and Cribl Cloud
  • Configure and manage data inputs to accommodate different types of data sources, including logs, metrics, and events to determine compliance with M-26-14 requirements at the FISMA system boundary level.
  • Establish and maintain secure and reliable connections between Splunk and external systems or data sources using Cribl Edge and Cribl Cloud
  • Monitor, and maintain alerts for failed data inputs.
  • Deign and recommend Cribl configurations for optimized performance and maximum cost savings
  • Design and implement log storage options maximizing cost efficiency while meeting standards of OMB M-26-14
  • Oversee the configuration and maintenance of Cribl and Splunk infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and security of the environment.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Cribl/Splunk functionality.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for incidents and implement preventive measures.
  • Monitor tool health and performance to identify issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Develop, review, and update existing operational documentation (SOPs, Job Aids, application checklists, playbooks, etc).
  • Support system access controls, including Account Management, Access Enforcement, Information Flow Enforcement, Least Privilege, and workflow for all user account requests and account recertifications.
  • Collaborate with the Security Operations Center (SOC) teams for process optimization, tool tuning, tool integration, information sharing, playbook development, and incident response.
  • Perform implementation, administration, operations and maintenance, optimization, & integration of cybersecurity tools, technologies, and services
  • Conduct regular Cribl/Splunk Enterprise upgrades for worker nodes, deployment servers, heavy forwarders, and syslog servers.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment as part of a stellar team of professionals, then we invite you to apply online today.

Benefits Snapshot (includes, but not limited to)Valiant pays 99% of the Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage for Full-time EmployeesValiant contributes 25% towards Health Coverage for Family and Dependents100% Paid Short Term Disability and Life Insurance Policy for Full-time Employees100% Paid Certifications401K Matching up to 4%Paid Time OffPaid Federal HolidaysWellness & Fitness ProgramValiant University – Online Education and Training PortalFSA programs for: Medical Costs, Dependent Care, Transit, and ParkingReferral Bonuses

The salary range for this position is a general guideline and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. It has been benchmarked in relation to the scope of the role, market rate, and internal equity. The salary for this role is expected to be in the $150,000 - $175,000 range. Where a candidate falls within the band can be determined based on one or more of the following: skillset, experience level, achievements, education, geographic location, security clearance, involvement in corporate tasks, and other non-discriminatory factors. In addition to the base salary, this role will include benefits as described above. Valiant reserves the right to adjust the salary range, experience requirements, and position responsibilities at any time without prior notice.

Remote Work Policy

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that align with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status, in accordance with applicable law.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods of time and consistent operation of a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as, personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Digital Experience Engineer (Web Development) – Military OneSource to develop, maintain, modernize, and enhance secure, accessible, and responsive websites and web applications that support military members and their families.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, enterprise content management systems, RESTful APIs, responsive design, accessibility, UX/UI implementation, and Agile delivery. This role is suited for a practical web engineer who can translate business, content, design, and accessibility requirements into reliable digital solutions while supporting production operations in a Federal environment.DecisionPoint is seeking an experienced Digital Experience Engineer (Web Development) – Military OneSource to support the MODES III program.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

WordPress & Web Development
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive websites and web applications supporting Military OneSource.
  • Configure, customize, and maintain WordPress websites, themes, templates, plugins, and reusable components.
  • Develop custom website functionality using PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and related web technologies.
  • Translate UX/UI designs, content requirements, and interaction specifications into responsive, accessible front-end solutions.
  • Support enterprise content management systems and database-backed web applications.
  • Troubleshoot website defects, broken functionality, display issues, integration problems, and production incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Digital Experience & Content Management
  • Partner with UX specialists, designers, content strategists, publishers, and product owners to improve the Military OneSource digital experience.
  • Support website content structures, templates, navigation, search, publishing workflows, and content presentation.
  • Translate business and user needs into practical, maintainable digital solutions.
  • Develop reusable components that promote visual consistency, usability, accessibility, and efficient content publishing.
  • Support website modernization, redesign, migration, and platform-enhancement initiatives.
  • Use website analytics, user feedback, accessibility results, and quality findings to recommend improvements.
Accessibility & Quality Assurance
  • Develop websites and applications consistent with Section 508, WCAG, and WAI-ARIA requirements.
  • Incorporate accessibility throughout design, development, testing, remediation, and release activities.
  • Perform keyboard, screen-reader, and assistive-technology validation as appropriate.
  • Use manual and automated accessibility testing tools to identify, document, and remediate issues.
  • Participate in peer reviews, code reviews, functional testing, usability reviews, and production validation.
API, Integration & Technical Support
  • Develop and maintain integrations among websites, RESTful APIs, databases, analytics platforms, and third-party services.
  • Implement interactive and dynamic website functionality using approved technologies and development standards.
  • Support authentication, search, forms, data exchange, and other integrated website capabilities.
  • Collaborate with back-end developers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, and DevSecOps engineers to resolve technical issues.
  • Support Git-based source control, structured development workflows, build tooling, deployment processes, and configuration management.
  • Assist with website monitoring, performance optimization, reliability, and production support.
Cybersecurity & Federal Compliance
  • Apply secure web-development practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Support vulnerability identification, remediation, validation, and release activities.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to support RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, privacy, CUI, and Authority to Operate requirements.
  • Follow applicable Federal and DoD development, security, privacy, records-management, and operational requirements.
  • Maintain technical documentation supporting application sustainment, security reviews, and knowledge transfer.
Agile Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Government stakeholders, product owners, business analysts, content teams, UX specialists, designers, architects, testers, and operations personnel.
  • Gather and clarify requirements, identify implementation options, and provide level-of-effort estimates.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Provide implementation documentation, status updates, issue reporting, and knowledge transfer while working independently within a multidisciplinary Agile team.
Why This Role MattersThe Digital Experience Engineer (Web Development) – Military OneSource will help modernize and sustain digital services used by military members and their families. The role combines hands-on WordPress development, front-end engineering, accessibility, UX implementation, content management, integration support, and production troubleshooting to deliver secure, reliable, and mission-focused digital experiences.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement
  • Must hold an active Secret clearance or higher.
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Web Development, Digital Media, or a related field. Equivalent relevant education, certifications, and professional experience may be considered.
Required Experience
  • Minimum 6 years of professional website, front-end, or web-application development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, and supporting production WordPress websites.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience translating UX/UI designs and business requirements into responsive, component-based web interfaces.
  • Experience developing or customizing WordPress themes, templates, plugins, and website functionality.
  • Experience supporting enterprise content management systems and content-publishing workflows.
  • Experience integrating websites with RESTful APIs, databases, third-party systems, or dynamic data services.
  • Experience with responsive web design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessible-development practices.
  • Experience applying Section 508 and WCAG requirements.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex website issues, investigating defects, and supporting production operations.
  • Experience using Git or another source-control platform and working within Agile or Scrum teams.
  • Ability to gather requirements and clearly communicate implementation options, risks, and recommended solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Experience & Certifications
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • IAAP accessibility certification, including CPACC, WAS, or CPWA, and/or DHS Trusted Tester certification.
  • Experience supporting Federal, DoD, or other regulated digital platforms and large-scale public-facing websites.
  • Experience with WordPress development in a Linux or LAMP environment.
  • Experience with Sass, NPM, Grunt, Gulp, or comparable front-end build tooling.
  • Experience with accessibility tools such as ANDI, axe, Lighthouse, or comparable testing solutions.
  • Experience with screen-reader, keyboard-only, and assistive-technology testing.
  • Experience developing search functionality, analytics integrations, interactive forms, calculators, or other custom features.
  • Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.
  • Familiarity with C#, .NET, Java, SQL, JSON, or other supporting application technologies.
  • Experience with AWS-hosted websites, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, or DevSecOps delivery.
  • Experience with Drupal or another enterprise content management platform.
  • Experience supporting website modernization, CMS migration, redesign, or platform-upgrade initiatives.
  • Experience with UX/UI collaboration, information architecture, visual design, SEO, analytics, or user-centered design.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish communication skills are beneficial.
Desired Professional Characteristics
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality work.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical problems and identify issues before deployment.
  • Ability to translate stakeholder expectations into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong customer-service, collaboration, and stakeholder-communication skills.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, standards, and technologies.
  • Ability to balance usability, accessibility, security, schedule, and technical requirements.
  • Commitment to improving digital services for military members and their families.
Join the MODES III team and help strengthen the digital experience behind Military OneSource.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Accountant to support the end-to-end accounting and month-end close processes for an assigned portfolio of clients. This role will take ownership of specific accounting tasks, support client deliverables, respond to client questions, and help maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.

The Senior Accountant may work independently on assigned tasks within a client engagement or, depending on the engagement, act as a Controller and lead Staff Accountant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support or own the end-to-end month-end close for an assigned portfolio of clients, which may include AP, AR, and payroll-related tasks.
  • Own specific accounting tasks within the month-end close cycle.
  • Prepare and support the delivery of client accounting deliverables.
  • Respond to client questions and follow up on outstanding items as needed.
  • Request, organize, and follow up on missing documentation from clients.
  • Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date records in accounting applications, including Double.
  • Identify and escalate open items, roadblocks, and issues to the Controller in advance of deadlines.
  • Support internal process improvements, efficiency initiatives, and other accounting team efforts.
  • Work closely with the Controller and other team members to ensure client engagements are completed accurately and on schedule.

Scope & Ownership

  • Own individual accounting tasks within a client engagement.
  • May act as the Controller and lead Staff Accountant for an assigned engagement, depending on the client structure.
  • Escalate engagement-level issues, open items, and roadblocks to the Controller as needed.

Requirements — Must Have

  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO).
  • Experience with inventory and cost accounting.
  • Experience with transactional accounting.
  • Advanced knowledge of accounting methods relevant to ecommerce or CPG businesses.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, current records.
  • Ability to manage deadlines, follow up on outstanding items, and proactively escalate issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) accounting.
  • Experience in ecommerce accounting.

Success in This Role

Success in this role means:

  • Month-end closes are completed on schedule with minimal corrections required from the Controller.
  • Client questions are addressed within agreed response times.
  • Open items and roadblocks are identified and escalated before deadlines.
  • Double is kept accurate and up to date for owned tasks.

raw.description:
The Eligibility Worker practices responsible, equitable, and professional community casework and case management in an inclusive team environment. Provides outstanding customer service delivery using a holistic approach to achieve customer satisfaction. Responsible with other team members for planning and
implementing team goals. In addition, performs responsible professional and technical work involving management of a benefits program caseload, respecting the broader need of individual clients and their families. Commitment to County, Department and unit goals, as well as the agency's Quality Customer Service Standards. As an organization, ACDSS is committed to building a diverse team of contributors who believe and work from the foundation of our core values of equity and inclusion, hope, respect, opportunity, and self-determination. Starting offer is based on applicable education, experience and internal equity.

Essential Functions:

  • Interviews applicants/recipients, adapting techniques to meet the needs/abilities of the client;
  • Determines eligibility for assistance and benefit levels using automated systems and manual methods; processes applications for benefit programs such as, but not limited to SNAP, Medicaid, Temporary Assistance to Needy Families (TANF), Energy, General Relief, Auxiliary Grants, Refugee Cash and/or Medical Assistance;
  • Compiles and analyzes information and policy to determine and redetermine ongoing eligibility for financial, medical and or other governmental programs; computes income and resource eligibility timely, accurately and completely based on complex state and federal guidelines; ensures clients receive maximum eligible benefits;
  • Explains available benefit programs, rights and responsibilities, other agency services and community resources identifies social problems and makes referrals to social workers as needed;
  • Researches, interprets, and applies mandated programmatic policy and procedures based on state and federal guidelines in the administration of a benefits caseload which may be generic or specialized;
  • Ensures integrity in benefits delivery and caseload management by maintaining records according to established guidelines and identifies errors/potential fraud and makes appropriate referrals; evaluates consistency and completeness of data secured, and where indicated substantiates its accuracy;
  • Responds to appeal requests, prepares appeal summaries and all supporting documentation, and participates in appeal hearings;
  • Attends and participates in unit and agency meetings by sharing knowledge, experiences, and information; participates in agency workgroups and/or teams; attends and participates in ongoing training, learning, and growth opportunities;
  • Recommends changes in internal policy and procedures based on experience and knowledge;
  • Performs related tasks as required.

Competency: Knowledge/ Skills/Abilities:

  • General knowledge of interviewing and time management skills and principles and practices of public social service organizations;
  • Some knowledge of current social, economic and health problems and of human behavior and social functioning;
  • Knowledge of mathematics to calculate percentages, formulas and averages to solve mathematical problems;
  • Knowledge of interviewing techniques such as data collection and investigation.
  • Ability to analyze information and policy and determine from a variety of sources missing information and gaps;
  • Ability to access data such as estates, retirement accounts, and real estate,
  • Ability to maintain professional ethics related to confidentiality; • Ability to work effectively within and around teams;
  • Ability to operate a computer and software;
  • High level of attention to detail;
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, co-workers, management and the public consistent with the agency’s Quality Caseload Standards;
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within a team environment;
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, tact and resourcefulness in solving problems and drawing logical conclusions;
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, orally and in writing;
  • Ability to prepare clear and concise reports;
  • Ability to organize/manage own work schedule;
  • Ability to plan, manage, coordinate, and prioritize multiple and varied activities and projects.

Required Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma supplemented with additional training and related work experience, or equivalent combination of training and experience.

Preferred Qualifications/Certifications:

Strongly preferred, but not required:

  • Bachelor's degree;
  • Direct eligibility experience;
  • Experience working effectively and successfully within a team;
  • Experience working with populations with limited English proficiency.

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Workers in this position are required to drive and they must meet the eligibility requirements of the County’s safe driver policy. Worker must be willing to travel occasionally overnight and may be required to assist in managing emergency shelters for the public. The candidate may be subject to criminal history and central registry background checks.
  • Works with the public; works typically in an office setting and/or telework environment;
  • Work is performed with relative independence;
  • May involve frequent walking or standing, and light lifting;
  • Regular operation of office equipment and occasional operation of vehicles;
  • Daily contact with clients, families, and the community in a positive and tactful manner under sometimes stressful situations.

Remote Work:

This position is eligible for remote work. All County staff must maintain residence within the Commonwealth of Virginia.

Albemarle County Core Values:

Albemarle County holds its employees to the highest standards in fulfilling the County’s Vision and Mission. We believe in excellence in public service through

Community: We expect diversity, equity and inclusion to be integrated into how we live our mission.

Integrity: We value our customers and co-workers by always providing honest and fair treatment.

Innovation: We embrace creativity and positive change.

Stewardship: We honor our role as stewards of the public trust by managing our natural, human, and financial resources respectfully and responsibly.

Learning: We encourage and support lifelong learning and personal and professional growth.

Overview

Flexible Worker Contract 

Location:Remote

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

T Level Technical Qualification in Health (Occupational Specialism - Supporting the Mental Health Team)

As an Examiner, you’ll use your subject knowledge to mark external assessments and submit results throughout the summer 2027 marking window, helping to ensure learners receive fair, consistent and accurate results.

If you’re a Mental Health or Mental Health Nursing teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor this is a great opportunity to put your expertise to use and make a valuable contribution to the assessment of learners.

Marking window dates are subject to change and will be communicated throughout the process should you be successful.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Following and maintaining the standard set by the Chief Examiner, applying the mark scheme consistently and accurately
  • Reporting suspected malpractice or safeguarding concerns to the Assessment Delivery team
  • Attending examiner standardisation and other meetings as required – standardisation events will be run remotely and scheduled for weekdays between the hours of 9.00am-5.00pm prior to the start of the marking window
  • Maintaining the confidentiality of NCFE assessment materials, learner evidence and learner details, and report any breaches to the Assessment Delivery team 

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:  

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in mental health or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent teaching experience at Level 3 or above in a mental health related subject, or significant recent occupational experience within the sector
  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.  

Shape real change with an NCFE career 

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.   

Want to know more? Take a look at our website 

How to apply 

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.  

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

 Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement 

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.  

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

raw.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in cloud and hybrid computing environments to support the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) at the U.
raw.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in cloud and hybrid computing environments to support the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) at the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS). In this senior-level role, you will serve as a key technical advisor and hands-on administrator across a complex hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises data center environments and multi-cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

Work location: Remote

What You Will Do:

  • Hybrid Systems Administration: Administer and maintain Windows Server and Linux/UNIX-based operating systems (Red Hat, Ubuntu, macOS, and comparable distributions) running on enterprise hardware including Dell, HP x86, and Oracle SPARC platforms across multiple physical data centers.
  • Virtualization Management: Administer VMware vCloud, vSphere, vCenter, and Enterprise Plus virtualization environments; manage VMware Operations (vROPS) and Log Insight for performance monitoring, optimization, and troubleshooting; support System Center Virtual Machine Manager (SCVMM) as needed.
  • Cloud Administration & Optimization: Administer and optimize AWS environments (EC2, S3, CloudFormation, Application Migration Service, and related services); provide expert guidance on cloud and cluster computing architectures; research, evaluate, and deploy advanced cloud computing capabilities and large-data analytics solutions for the program.
  • Migration & Modernization: Lead and support data integration and workload migration efforts from on-premises infrastructure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP); document migration paths, develop runbooks, and execute cutovers with minimal-to-no customer downtime.
  • Storage & Backup/DR Administration: Administer NAS and SAN storage devices; manage enterprise backup software; implement and maintain Backup-to-Cloud replication and disaster recovery (DR) solutions to meet program continuity requirements.
  • Architecture Advisory: Advise OCIO leadership and program stakeholders on cloud and hybrid computing architectures, system and memory management optimization across distributed platforms, and best practices for workload placement and resource utilization.
  • Security & Patch Management: Apply OS, hypervisor, and application-level security patches to resolve vulnerabilities; maintain compliance with DOI/USGS security standards and Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) remediation timelines.
  • Monitoring, Observability & Incident Response: Design and maintain operational monitoring dashboards (vROPS, Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable tools) for CPU, memory, and storage utilization; troubleshoot and resolve performance and availability incidents across physical, virtual, and cloud infrastructure.
  • DevOps & Automation Support: Leverage container and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Jenkins, Ansible, or comparable platforms) to support workload modernization, CI/CD pipeline operations, and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration records, migration plans, and runbooks; collaborate using Government-provided tools (Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams).

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience, or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience, or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States
  • Extensive experience in systems administration across hybrid IT environments (on-premises + cloud).
  • VMware Virtualization: Demonstrated expertise administering vCenter, ESXi/vSphere (6.x/7.x/8.x), vROPS, and VMware Log Insight in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • AWS Cloud Services: Hands-on experience with EC2, S3, CloudFormation, and workload migration tooling (e.g., Application Migration Service); ability to design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting production workloads.
  • Windows & Linux/UNIX: Proficiency administering Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) and Linux/UNIX environments (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu) in enterprise or Federal settings.
  • Enterprise Storage: Experience managing NAS, SAN, and enterprise hardware platforms from Dell, HP, NetApp, or comparable vendors.
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery: Working knowledge of enterprise backup and replication solutions; experience designing or implementing Backup-to-Cloud and DR strategies.
  • Multi-Cloud Environments: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, and GCP; ability to advise on workload placement, cost optimization, and architecture trade-offs.
  • Identity & Access Management: Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, PKI, and enterprise IAM.
  • Zero-Downtime Operations: Demonstrated ability to perform zero-downtime upgrades, migrations, and hardware decommissions in production environments.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; ability to produce technical documentation and present to technical peers and senior leadership.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Enterprise Architecture or a related technical field is strongly preferred
  • AWS Certification: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or equivalent AWS certification.
  • VMware Certification: VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV or VCP-VCF) or equivalent VMware certification.
  • Kubernetes & Containers: Experience with Kubernetes (on-premises, AWS, or bare metal) and container orchestration for production workloads.
  • DevOps Tooling: Jenkins (CI/CD), Ansible (configuration management/automation), or comparable pipeline tools.
  • Monitoring Platforms: Datadog, Splunk, Elasticsearch, or VMware Log Insight for enterprise observability.
  • PaaS Platforms: Exposure to Pivotal Cloud Foundry or comparable PaaS platforms in enterprise or multi-cloud environments.
  • Federal/USGS Experience: Prior support of USGS, DOI, or other Federal OCIO environments; familiarity with CHS (Cloud Hosting Solutions) infrastructure.
  • Agile/Scrum: Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or comparable Agile certification; experience working in sprint-based delivery models.
  • AI/Cloud-Native Capabilities: AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Generative AI credentials, or hands-on experience with cloud-native AI/ML services.
  • Oracle on Linux: Experience with Oracle databases on KVM/Red Hat Linux or comparable enterprise database infrastructure.
  • Team Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring junior technical staff in a professional IT environment.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.description:
QuadMed is looking for a Growth and Business Development Lead to join our growing team. This is a remote role with some travel to Wisconsin required.

GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB

The Growth and Business Development Lead supports QuadMed’s growth objectives through business development, relationship-building, sales technology and CRM optimization, seller enablement, sales operations, pipeline management, reporting, and market development. This role identifies and develops potential business opportunities through lead-generation activities, referrals, market relationships, research, and networking, while facilitating appropriate qualification, follow-up, and handoff to Sales. The role also serves as a lead operational resource for the tools, data, campaigns, workflows, and processes that enable seller effectiveness and support pipeline development. The Growth and Business Development Lead partners closely with the Vice Presidents of Growth, Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to improve sales effectiveness and support business growth. This is a lead-level individual contributor position with no direct reports.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Engage prospective customers through referrals, lead-generation activities, networking, and other appropriate opportunities to build relationships, generate interest, and facilitate appropriate follow-up or handoff to Sales.
  • Proactively identify, research, prospect, and qualify new business opportunities through targeted outreach, referrals, market relationships, events, and other lead-generation activities.
  • Qualify inbound leads by assessing organizational needs, business fit, decision-making authority, timing, and other relevant qualification criteria.
  • Maintain sufficient knowledge of QuadMed's services, capabilities, and value proposition to effectively represent the organization and facilitate initial connections with prospective customers and market contacts.
  • Facilitate warm introductions and appropriate handoff of referrals and potential business opportunities to Sales, ensuring relevant relationship and opportunity information is documented and communicated.
  • Achieve established goals for prospecting activity, qualified opportunities, meetings, pipeline development, and other applicable growth measures.
  • Research target accounts, industries, decision-makers, competitors, and market trends to support prospecting, targeting, account planning, market development, and Growth activities.
  • Administer, maintain, and optimize QuadMed's CRM, prospecting, growth marketing, sales-enablement, reporting, and related sales technology platforms to support seller productivity and growth objectives.
  • Maintain CRM standards and data integrity while ensuring prospect interactions, qualification information, leads, accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, and next steps are accurately and consistently documented.
  • Develop and maintain CRM reports, dashboards, pipeline summaries, and performance metrics to provide visibility into sales activity, pipeline health, opportunity progression, and business performance.
  • Partner with Growth and Marketing to operationalize campaigns and demand-generation activities, including CRM campaign setup, audience and list management, invitations, response tracking, confirmations, lead routing, follow-up coordination, and reporting.
  • Develop and maintain sales and marketing enablement materials, including presentations, playbooks, market-specific resources, process documentation, training materials, and user guidance to support seller effectiveness and adoption of sales technology tools and processes.
  • Represent QuadMed at selected Wisconsin business, healthcare, community, networking, and industry events to build relationships, gather market intelligence, increase market awareness, identify potential referrals and opportunities, and facilitate appropriate connections to Sales.
  • Maintain current knowledge of QuadMed's services, target markets, competitors, industry trends, and effective prospecting and sales practices to continuously strengthen business development effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize sales processes, improve data quality and tool adoption, and leverage technology, including AI, to improve service delivery, seller effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
  • Perform other growth-enablement duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Appropriate education and/or experience may be substituted on an equivalent basis

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, sales, marketing, communications, healthcare administration, information systems, analytics, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Five (5) or more years of relevant experience in business development, sales development, sales operations, growth operations, sales enablement, CRM administration, or a related field.
  • Experience using CRM and related sales technology platforms to manage prospecting activities, leads, opportunities, pipeline data, reporting, and sales workflows.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Operations, IT, Analytics, or other business functions to support growth initiatives and process improvements.
  • Experience in healthcare, employer-sponsored healthcare, employee benefits, B2B sales, or the Wisconsin business market preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong business development skills with the ability to engage prospective customers through multiple communication channels.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively represent QuadMed and communicate its services and capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of CRM processes, sales technology, pipeline management, sales operations, data quality, reporting, and workflow optimization.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to identify target accounts, market trends, potential business opportunities, data gaps, process issues, and operational risks.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder requests.
  • Strong relationship-building, networking, and stakeholder-management skills with the professional presence to represent QuadMed effectively with prospects, clients, brokers, consultants, business leaders, and community contacts.
  • Ability to work independently as a lead-level individual contributor, demonstrating initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Adaptability and flexibility in a fast-paced healthcare and sales environment, including the ability to travel within Wisconsin as needed.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse populations and a demonstrated commitment to fostering inclusion.
  • Demonstrated commitment to growing proficiency in the use of AI tools to drive efficiency and innovation across operations.
  • Ability to translate Growth, Marketing, and business requirements into practical workflows, reports, documentation, enablement resources, and system enhancements.
  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and discretion in handling confidential business and customer information.

Employees can be expected to be paid an annualized salary range of $75,000 - $80,000, based on variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions.

The primary moderation period will be between April and August 2027, during which your engagement will be most critical.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Conducting moderation activities in line with awarding organisation and regulatory requirements
  • Attending standardisation and team meetings as required
  • Reviewing centre marking to ensure assessment decisions are accurate, consistent and meet required standards
  • Producing clear, accurate and timely moderation reports within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Planning and managing moderation activity for allocated centres in line with sampling strategies and quality assurance requirements
  • Supporting continuous improvement by identifying areas for development and sharing best practice
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the qualification, assessment requirements and your subject-specialist area

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in care of children and young people or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent occupational experience working within the care of children and young people sector
  • Experience of teaching, assessing, internal quality assuring and/or moderating vocational or academic qualifications
  • Strong knowledge of assessment and quality assurance processes
  • Excellent written communication and report-writing skills
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards and delivering a positive experience for centres

Shape real change with an NCFE career

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Ordnance and Tactical Systems (OTS) is a global leader in the design, engineering and production of munitions, energetics, weapons, armaments, and missile subsystems around the world. OTS empowers the U.S. military and its allies with an extensive range of overarching product segments applied across all levels of strategic and tactical operations, providing a cutting-edge advantage to our warfighters. Our Ethos of Honesty, Trust, Transparency, and Alignment, are the guiding principles that form the foundation of everything we do. Integrity is paramount, innovation fuels our passion, customer satisfaction is at the core of our mission, and collaboration is key to our success - fostering a culture of teamwork and mutual respect among employees, partners, and stakeholders. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement, and work/life benefits that include career development and recognition programs. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Job Summary

We are currently seeking a Principal Mechanical Engineer to join our growing Solid Rocket Motor Engineering Team. The ideal candidate will have experience as Mechanical Design Engineer for solid rocket motors. That would include Mechanical Design Integration of Solid Propulsion Systems, mechanical system design, mass properties and integrating all sub-assemblies. They will be responsible for the design, development, and integration of mechanical components used in solid rocket motor systems. This role focuses on creating CAD models, engineering drawings, and specifications for critical hardware such as motor cases, nozzles, insulation systems, joints, and structural interfaces. This position can be remote or at our Huntsville, AL, Niceville FL, or Hampton, AR facility.

Impact of the Role

General Profile

  • Requires specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own job discipline or field
  • Uses advanced techniques, theories, and processes to complete work
  • Leads others to solve complex problems
  • Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations
  • May lead functional teams or projects
  • Consistent exercise of discretion & judgment

Essential Functions

  • Applies advanced engineering techniques to design, install, modify, analyze, repair and test tools, engines, machines, and other mechanically functioning equipment.
  • Guides the interpretation of blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
  • Collaborates with engineers and other personnel to implement operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and provide technical information.
  • Researches and analyzes customer design proposals, specifications, manuals, and other data to evaluate the feasibility, cost, and maintenance requirements of designs or applications.
  • Specifies system components or directs modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications.
  • Investigates equipment failures and difficulties to diagnose faulty operation and makes recommendations to maintenance crew.

      • Required Qualifications

      • Required education and experience: Associate's Degree and 8-10 years' experience
      • Discipline/Major: Engineering degree required
      • Critical professional related technical skills; computer skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

      Preferred Qualifications

      • Preferred education and experience: Bachelor's Degree
      • Knowledge, skills & abilities: Oral and written communication skills. Ability to meet deadlines. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Problem-solving skills. Analytical thinking skills. Applied mechanics. Design engineering. Design optimization. Design review. Mechanical engineering. Prototyping. Requirements engineering/analysis. CAD software. Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) software.

      Additional Responsibilities:

      • Perform detailed thermal analysis of solid rocket motor components.
      • Size internal insulation, external thermal protection systems, and structural insulators.
      • Validate models with test data; develop predictive ablation and erosion models.
      • Define sub-scale tests for characterizing material properties of insulators and ablators.
      • Evaluate and recommend ablative materials and thermal protection system solutions for applications in solid rocket motors
      • Create reports and presentations documenting analysis and other supporting work.
      • Present to peers and customers in design reviews.

      Physical Requirements

      • Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time.
      • Requires regular movement throughout GD-OTS facilities.
      • May need to stand for long periods of time.
      • Work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential.
      • Work may require employee to work inside and outside with exposure to changing climate and/or operate machinery.
      • May be requested to work a different shift.

      Travel Requirements

      Up to 25% travel likely.

      Pay Range (USD)

      $114/k-$154/k

      Pay Transparency Statement

      The salary range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum for salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, internal equity, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the range during the hiring process.

      Additional Compensation

      Hired applicant may be eligible to participate in the Company’s Gain Sharing Program.

      Benefits

      Employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and basic life insurance as well as pre-tax spending accounts. Employees are also able to enroll in the company's 401k plan and are eligible for the Non-Contributory Retirement Contribution. In addition to the benefits discussed above, the company offers the following voluntary benefits: Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Identify Theft Protection, Enhanced Legal Services, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Educational Assistance, Employee Assistance Program

      Paid Time Off

      Employees will receive paid holidays and 120 hours of PTO annually and up to 3 weeks paid family leave. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work only. The statements do not represent an exhaustive list of required responsibilities and skills. Other duties may be added or this job description may be amended at any time. This job description does not alter an employee's at-will employment status or create an employment agreement or contract, implied or otherwise.
