raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position for applicants based in Canada or the US.

About the role

The Global Account Director is responsible for driving business transformation, long-term value, and growth for Kinaxis' largest global enterprise customers. This role leads the development and execution of global account strategies, leveraging deep expertise in SaaS solutions, end-to-end supply chain management, and strategic consulting. The Global Account Director will influence executive stakeholders, manage complex global relationships, orchestrate cross-functional teams, and collaborate closely with Sales on Next-Sell opportunities. This role is responsible for influencing Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and generating Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) through strategic opportunity identification.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

  • Orchestrate and lead Kinaxis’ relationships with key global stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their organizational structures, strategic goals, and supply chain.
  • Develop and implement a governance model to manage global enterprise accounts, ensuring consistent delivery of high-value solutions.
  • Lead the cross functional Kinaxis team, leveraging the expertise from Product Management, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, and integration partners to develop a unified strategy that drives customer transformation and meets business objectives.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Renewals teams to create joint account plans, identify and qualify expansion opportunities, and drive growth through SQL generation and conversion.
  • Influence NRR performance by driving adoption, enabling retention readiness, and identifying expansion triggers across your portfolio.
  • Oversee light commercial responsibilities, including tracking and managing licenses, users, and scenarios to enhance account value and drive growth.
  • Act as a primary liaison between Kinaxis and the customer’s executive leadership, delivering insight into how Kinaxis solutions can address evolving business challenges.
  • Influence and negotiate for roadmap alignment with customers, ensuring that Kinaxis innovations are prioritized to meet strategic business goals.
  • Champion change management initiatives to ensure seamless solution adoption across all levels of the customer organization, enabling full business transformation and value realization.
  • Collaborate with customers to define and track customer-specific KPIs and business impact metrics, providing strategic recommendations to support value realization and continued expansion.
  • Manage escalations swiftly and effectively, collaborating with internal teams to develop rapid-response strategies that preserve customer trust and satisfaction.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience managing Forbes Top 100 and global accounts, with a proven track record of leading high-impact, strategic client relationships and driving business transformation.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders and build consensus across cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success working with cross-functional teams and orchestrating multi-region enterprise strategies that deliver both retention and growth.
  • Strong Expertise in Supply Chain Management, including deep knowledge of processes, systems, and industry best practices.
  • Proven ability to identify and qualify expansion opportunities, influencing portfolio NRR and SQL generation while collaborating closely with Sales and Renewals.
  • Proven ability to work with SaaS solutions, leveraging technology to drive business outcomes and optimize supply chain operations.
  • Extensive experience utilizing Salesforce (SFDC) and Gainsight to manage customer relationships, track account health and opportunities, and driving proactive engagement.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification considered an asset
  • Ability to travel up to 20% to global client sites, subsidiaries, and industry events as required.

#Senior; #Director

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

About The Company:

Our client is a decentralized, multi-chain structured-products protocol focused on developing next-generation RFQ architecture to power a wide range of options products across multiple protocols. They are committed to delivering secure, scalable, and innovative DeFi solutions, leveraging AI-driven tooling to enhance user strategies and experiences.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with AI capabilities to lead the development and scaling of our protocol UI/UX, APIs, vault mechanics, and AI-powered features. This role combines full-stack engineering with AI integration, focusing on building intelligent dashboards, predictive risk models, and smart automation to enhance user yield strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement front-end components (React, TypeScript) and back-end systems (Node.js, Python, Go), including vault logic, API endpoints, and integrations with lending and AMM protocols.

  • Architect and deploy AI features such as predictive analytics, risk signal models, and recommender systems to inform vault strategies and user decisions.

  • Collaborate with UI/UX designers to deliver intuitive, engaging experiences for DeFi users.

  • Ensure secure development practices for smart contract interactions, vault mechanics, and chain interoperability.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and DevOps workflows for seamless deployment.

  • Monitor, debug, and optimize protocol performance and reliability.

  • Stay up to date with AI frameworks, tools, and DeFi best practices to continuously enhance the tech stack and user impact.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years of full-stack development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Vue) and back-end stacks (Node.js, Python, Go).

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) or AI-augmented development tools (e.g., Copilot, LLM integrations).

  • Strong understanding of DeFi concepts, including vaults, AMMs, lending protocols, and smart contract integration.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of blockchain networks, Web3 libraries, and security best practices.

The following would be nice to have:

  • Proven experience building intelligent dashboards or ML-backed financial systems.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools or integrating AI agents via protocols like MCP.

  • Prior experience shipping production-grade DeFi UIs or smart contract front-ends.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices for financial protocols.

raw.description:
An exciting opportunity exists to join the ProAssurance family of companies!

Our mission is powerful and simple: We protect others. Choosing a place to apply your talents is an important decision for anyone. You have plenty of options. Why choose ProAssurance?

At ProAssurance, we sell a pledge, and that pledge is delivered by our team members. We are seeking individuals who value integrity, leadership, relationships, and enthusiasm—and want to build their career with a great company where they can be their authentic self and feel valued, recognized, and rewarded for their contributions. ProAssurance specializes in healthcare professional liability, products liability for medical technology and life sciences, legal professional liability, and workers' compensation insurance. We are an industry-leading specialty insurer, with job opportunities in much of the contiguous United States.

This position supports our workers' compensation line of business, Eastern Alliance. This is a remote role, based in Georgia or South Carolina, but could also accommodate Charlotte NC. Candidates located in Augusta GA, Charlotte NC, Atlanta GA and Columbia SC would be well located to meet the travel requirements of the position.

The primary responsibility of the Senior Marketing Representative position is to work in conjunction with the Regional Vice President and Director(s) of Marketing and Regional Underwriting to profitably manage the Company’s agency distribution network by providing field marketing support to the regional service teams. In support of the regional Strategic Plan, the Senior Marketing Representative is responsible for working within a service team structure to co-develop/establish individual agency management strategies and execution of the same throughout the year. These individual strategies should be focused on securing/retaining profitable business in all of the Company’s business segments. This position is accountable for identifying and evaluating potential agency partners based upon the regional strategic plan and working with the regional service teams to improve the performance of existing agency partners. In support of the regional services teams, the Senior Marketing Representative will analyze the monthly report data available to identify either positive or negative trends and then share these observations them. This position will deliver an unparalleled level of service to the Company’s agency with the ultimate goal of achieving annual business goals and objectives.

What you'll do:

  • 30% - Support each of the regional service teams to manage the Company’s agency distribution. Monitor agency results on a timely basis and push the appropriate date to the appropriate service team; recognize and troubleshoot areas of difference and plan/recommend corrective action for profitable results. Coordinate and monitor visits with other Company representatives.
  • 15% - Coordinate and participate in the execution of the annual agency business planning and regularly monitor results, recommend, and take action when necessary.
  • 5% - Coordinate and manage all regional agency outing and marketing events (internal/external).
  • 5% - Advocate the Company as carrier of choice to new and prospective agencies; promote new products and services and assist in identifying new product opportunities and/or enhancements of current products.
  • 5% - Prospect, qualify and recommend for appointment agencies in assigned territory to build and maintain a profitable agency distribution network. Set-up and maintain all new agencies within the Company database.
  • 5% - Coordinate all new agency orientation meetings including producing all the necessary meeting materials.
  • 5% - Oversee the technical management of the Company’s Agency Agreement, Profit Incentive Plan and commission plans within assigned territories.
  • 5% - Coordinate with the regional Agency Advisory Council meetings through attendance, planning and participation. Manage recommendations and follow-up on action plans.
  • 5% - Manage agency/producer training and education programs. Identify new programs for producer development.
  • 5% - Participate and take leadership role with Company initiatives (i.e. – Return to Wellness, eaport and Parallel Pay).
  • 5% - Promote company technology initiatives with producers/CSRs, monitor usage of CS STARS and eaport and other technology. Provide additional training as necessary.
  • 5% - Assist and support the development of the region’s annual strategic plan.
  • 5% - Assist with the creation of and coordinate the annual regional marketing, public relations, and advertising budget.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or marketing plus seven years P&C experience. A P&C multidisciplinary background with specific experience in marketing is preferred.
  • Ability to build relationships with agency partners and prospects.
  • Ability to promote and sell the Company’s products and service to the marketplace; ability to represent the Company in a professional manner; ability to make presentations to large groups of people.
  • Ability to attend insurance industry/business functions to promote and present a positive image of the Company.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications including Word, Excel, and Power Point.
  • Analytical ability to make profitable decisions about agency partners.
  • Ability to analyze the competitive markets, identify trends and make recommendation to remain competitive in market.
  • Attention to detail in presenting information, establishing priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally both verbally and in writing with various constituencies and at all levels; both in and outside of the organization including agency partners, outside customers, and clients.
  • Ability to travel regularly, approximately 40% includes frequent overnight travel; valid driver’s license required.

We are committed to providing a dynamic and inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work and grow personally and professionally.

For that reason, we partner with The Predictive Index (PI) – an organization equally committed to improving the working lives of people, to help us hire the best talent by providing additional insight about one’s work style.

The position you applied to requires completion of two assessments prior to being scheduled to interview with a hiring manager. A Talent Acquisition team member may review your application and contact you before the assessment is complete.These assessments are Behavioral and Cognitive, and each assessment takes less than 12 minutes to complete.

After submitting your application, you will receive two emails from The Predictive Index inviting you to complete each of these assessments (please check your SPAM or Junk email folder if you do not see these emails in your inbox).

Note: If you already completed the assessments as part of an application with us, we may have results on file and you may not receive the emails inviting you to take the assessments. If you are moving forward in the process, a Talent Acquisition team member will confirm if we already have your assessment results.

Position Salary Range

$66,229.00 - $109,289.00

The salary range displayed represents the entirety of the pay grade for this position. Most candidates will start in the bottom half of the range. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have, your location and comparison to other team members already in this role.

Build your career with us and enjoy access to a best-in-class benefits program.
